plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enter-swap

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件：**输入框 Enter = 换行，Shift+Enter = 发送**。
极简、零依赖、无设置页、行为固定，装完即用。

## 功能

- **Enter → 换行；Shift+Enter → 发送**
- **输入框右下角常驻键位徽标：〔Shift+Enter 发送消息〕〔Enter 换行〕**（0.1.2 起；不拦截鼠标，主题中性灰，随输入框伸缩自动跟随）
- Ctrl/Cmd+Enter（原生加速投递）、Alt+Enter 保持原生
- 中文输入法组词过程不拦截（IME 组帧放行）
- 斜杠命令 / @提及候选菜单打开时，Enter 照常选中菜单项
- 无设置页、无网络请求、无文件读写、零 npm 依赖

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xuqiuba888/dsh-enter-swap
```

其他 profile 同理（`--profile <名>`）。装完重启 dsh（Desktop/NEXT 重启应用），
浏览器/界面硬刷新（Ctrl+Shift+R）生效。

### 卸载与更新

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-enter-swap   # 更新到最新
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-enter-swap   # 卸载，刷新即回原生
```

## 文件结构

```
├── package.json         # dsh.client（Web 插件）+ dsh.bundle（profile patch）声明
├── cordis.patch.yml     # bundle patch：插入插件行
├── pnpm-lock.yaml       # 依赖快照（零依赖，仅为 link 安装惯例）
├── lib/
│   └── index.js         # Host 半部：空实现（本插件不需要宿主行为）
└── client/
    └── client.js        # Client 半部：捕获阶段按键互换
```

## 实现要点

- 在 document 捕获阶段监听 `keydown`，仅当目标位于输入框
  （`[data-composer-input="true"]`）内才处理
- 手势判定：Alt/Ctrl/Cmd 一律放行；`isComposing` / keyCode 229 放行；
  检测到挂载在 `<body>` 直下且**可见**的 portal 菜单（`role="menu" /
  "listbox"`，即斜杠/@候选弹层）时放行，Enter 照常选中菜单项——隐藏的
  残留弹层（如新开会话后的工作区选择器）不算菜单开着
- 命中时 `preventDefault + stopPropagation`，再把互换后的手势以合成
  KeyboardEvent 派发回引擎——**语义（发送/排队/换行）仍由引擎自己决定**
- Client bundle 为纯 JS，`__ModuleLoader__` 工厂格式，无需构建步骤

## 兼容性

DSH 0.2.x（在 0.2.1-rc.2 web 界面上开发并验证）。不使用任何引擎版本特定的
内部 API。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: hold Ctrl and tap Tab to switch between recently viewed sessions; release the modifier to open the highlighted one. Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backwards.
plugins.readme_text:
# Session Switcher

English overview below · 完整详细文档为简体中文，见 [中文说明](#中文说明)

Session Switcher (`dsh-session-switcher`) is a plugin for **DSH Desktop** that brings hold-to-switch navigation to your recently viewed sessions. Hold `Ctrl` and tap `Tab` to open a floating list of recent sessions with the next target highlighted; tap `Tab` again to move down, then release the modifier(s) to open the highlighted session (`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` moves backwards and `Esc` cancels). The highlight moves while the modifier is held, so you can skip past sessions before committing on release. It is built for DSH Desktop: in a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Hold `Ctrl`, tap `Tab` | Open the list and highlight the next recently viewed session; tap again to move down |
| `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `Tab` | Move the highlight backwards |
| Release the modifier(s) | Open the highlighted session and close the list |
| `Esc` | Cancel without switching |
| `Enter` / click a row | Open that session immediately |
| `↑` / `↓` | Move the highlight while the list is open |
| Click outside / window blur | Cancel |

## 安装 / Installation

### 从插件管理器安装（推荐）/ Install from the plugin manager

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle, so DSH's own plugin manager can install and enable it:

1. Open the **Plugins** page in DSH (the plugin manager page in the sidebar; 中文界面为「插件」).
2. Select **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**（「添加插件」→「安装第三方插件」）.
3. Enter the repository address and select **Install**:

   ```text
   https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
   ```

4. If DSH asks for a restart, restart DSH Desktop. The installer adds the dependency to your profile and enables the bundle for you; no manual configuration is needed.

To disable or uninstall the plugin later, use the same **Plugins** page.

### 命令行安装 / Install with the CLI

The same installation is available from the `dsh` CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
```

Use `--profile <name>` to target a specific profile (for example `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...`). The CLI may ask you to restart DSH afterwards. You can also install the release tarball — paste the download link of the `dsh-session-switcher-1.3.0.tgz` asset from the [Releases page](https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher/releases) into the same dialog or command.

### 本地开发安装 / Local checkout (development)

To hack on the plugin, run a checkout as a linked bundle. Prefer DSH's own installer — it writes the `link:` dependency **and** runs the profile's package install, so the checkout is linked into the profile; editing the manifest by hand alone skips that step and the bundle is skipped at startup.

1. Clone the repository into your DSH bundles directory (`~/.dsh/bundles/`; Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\bundles\`):

   ```bash
   # macOS / Linux
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git ~/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   ```powershell
   # Windows (PowerShell)
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\bundles\session-switcher"
   ```

2. Install the checkout through the same add-plugin flow, pointing it at the local directory: **Plugins** page → **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin** → enter the absolute path of the checkout (`/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, `/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, or `C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`). Or use the CLI:

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add /home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   DSH records a `link:` dependency, installs it into the profile, and enables the bundle.

3. Restart DSH Desktop. After later edits to the checkout, restart DSH Desktop (or disable and re-enable the bundle on the **Plugins** page) to remount the client module.

#### 手动回退 / Fallback: edit the profile manifest by hand

Only if the installer cannot be used. Edit the DSH Desktop profile manifest, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`), to add the dependency and the bundle selection:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-switcher": "link:/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-session-switcher"]
    }
  }
}
```

Use the absolute path of your clone: `/home/<you>/...` on Linux, `/Users/<you>/...` on macOS, `C:/Users/<you>/...` on Windows (JSON paths use forward slashes on every OS); from the profile directory the relative form `link:../../bundles/session-switcher` resolves to the same location. Then relink and reinstall the profile — without this the linked package never reaches `node_modules` and the bundle is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

Restart DSH Desktop afterwards.

> **浏览器 / Browser:** the shortcuts target DSH Desktop. In a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

## 中文说明

DSH Desktop 插件：按住 `Ctrl` 敲 `Tab`，弹出「最近会话」浮动小窗，高亮待切换的会话；
**松开修饰键即打开高亮会话**并收起小窗。

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+Tab`（按住 Ctrl 连按 Tab） | 打开浮动窗，高亮「下一个最近查看的会话」；继续按 Tab 依次下移 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` | 反向移动高亮 |
| 松开修饰键 | 打开高亮会话，关闭小窗 |
| `Esc` | 取消，不切换 |
| `Enter` / 鼠标点击某一行 | 立即打开该会话 |
| `↑` / `↓` | 移动高亮（小窗打开时） |
| 点击小窗外 / 窗口失焦 | 取消 |

- 插件按 DSH Desktop 设计：浏览器里 `Ctrl+Tab` 归浏览器所有，插件不会被触发。
- macOS 同样使用 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab`（`Cmd+Tab` 是系统应用切换，应用收不到）。

### 实现要点：为什么用 fixed 输入而不是可编辑快捷键

DSH Desktop 的**原生键盘桥**会先于页面拦截「可编辑快捷键」的按键组合，然后 Electron
会吞掉随后的**修饰键 keyup**（DSH 官方 shortcuts 文档的 “Understand the implementation” 一节
也说明：Electron 在原生拦截之后可能省略 keyup）。一旦 `Ctrl` 的 keyup 到不了页面，浮动窗就无法知道「Ctrl 已松开」，
只能等下一次按键——这正是早期版本「松开 Ctrl 无反应、要再按一次 Ctrl 才切换」的根因
（已用合成按键 + UI Automation 实测复现：`Ctrl+Tab`、`Ctrl+B` 等任何可编辑快捷键之后
都收不到 `keyup`）。

因此 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 注册为 **fixed 输入动作**（`ctx.shortcuts.registerFixed`
+ `ctx.shortcuts.observeFixedInput`）：fixed 动作不走原生桥拦截，留在正常的 DOM 输入路径，
修饰键 keyup 可以正常收到，于是「松手提交」可靠。代价是这两行在
**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts**（`Mod+/`）里显示为只读条目（Application 分组，键帽
`Ctrl + Tab` / `Ctrl + Shift + Tab`），不能改键；不想要时停用/卸载插件即可。

#### 为什么点击行曾「只关窗、不切换」（已修复）

DSH 的 shortcuts 服务在**每个 `pointerdown`** 上都会给 fixed 输入观察者发一次
`{ type: "reset" }`（用于中断多键序列）。早期版本把 reset 一律当作取消：鼠标按下瞬间
小窗就被卸载，行的 React `click` 永远来不及触发——于是「点一下小窗消失，但会话没切换」。
现在的做法是：在 **window 捕获阶段**（早于 shortcuts 服务的 document 捕获 reset）先判断
这次按下是否落在小窗内；**落在窗内的按下不算取消**，只吞掉紧接着的 reset，让行正常收到
click 并切换；点到窗外仍然立即取消。松开指针（`pointerup`/`pointercancel`）后恢复常规
reset 行为。

### 参考实现

当前 ChatGPT / Codex 桌面端（2026，版本 26）把 `Ctrl+Tab` 定义为 **“Next recently viewed chat”**，
`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 为 **“Previous recently viewed chat”**（另有 `Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp`、
`Ctrl+Shift+]`/`[` 等别名）；Codex 应用更新日志也提到加入了「跳转到最近线程的键盘快捷键」。
本插件按这个语义实现：

- 列表 = **最近查看顺序（MRU）**：当前会话 → 查看历史（最近查看的在前）→ 其余会话按侧边栏
  最近更新排序；每次查看会话都会更新查看历史；
- 按住修饰键时只移动高亮，**松开才切换**（VS Code / Alt-Tab 式 hold-modifier switcher）；
- 列表跳过已归档会话和子代理（subagent）会话；当前未开始的新会话排在最前。

参考链接：

- <https://defkey.com/chatgpt-windows-app-2026-shortcuts>（ChatGPT Windows App 26.x 快捷键表）
- <https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog?type=codex-app>（Codex app 更新日志）

### 样式

面板沿用 DSH 菜单样式：`--dsw-specific-menu` 表面、`--dsw-elevation-prominent` 阴影、
`--dsw-radius-xl` 圆角、`--dsw-alias-state-business-primary` 选中强调色，跟随明暗主题；
行内显示会话标题、所属工作区与相对时间，当前会话带「当前」标记。

某一行的会话**正在运行**（active turn）时，行右侧显示一个 14px 的旋转圆圈，复用 DSH
侧边栏 `StateDot` 的 ongoing 外观：1.5s 线性旋转 + 1.5s 虚线弧动画，描边继承
`--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下两段动画停止、弧固定。运行状态
来自 frame 槽作用域提供的 `useSessionStatus` 钩子（实时订阅），取不到时回退到会话列表
快照里的 `running` 提示；它会和「当前」标记并排显示，但始终位于最右侧。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 包清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 bundle 补丁，`dsh.client` 声明浏览器半体 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 向 profile 配置树插入 Host 行 `session-switcher` |
| `index.js` | Host 半体（无需挂载任何服务，空 `apply`） |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半体：fixed 输入动作 + `shell.overlay` 浮动窗 + 页面级 keyup/keydown 负责「松手提交 / Esc 取消」，并订阅会话列表维护最近查看顺序；window 捕获阶段区分「点中面板」与「点外取消」；运行中的会话行右侧渲染 `useSessionStatus` 旋转圆圈；内置中英文运行时文案 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件市场/设置页里的标题与描述（中英文） |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `verify-client.cjs` | 本地校验脚本（不参与运行时）：用桩 React/DOM/服务执行真实 `client

plugins.description: 小舞 · DSH 桌宠：原创 SVG 手绘兔耳少女，跟随 agent 状态换动作，运行时合成甜声说「做完啦……」。无任何外部素材或录音。
plugins.readme_text:
# 小舞 · DSH 桌宠（dsh-plugin-xiaowu）

一个常驻 DSH Web 界面右下角的桌面宠物插件。她会跟着当前会话里 agent 的工作状态换动作，
任务做完的时候跳起来撒花，并且用一段**运行时合成的甜美声音**说一句「做完啦……」。
声音不是任何录音或采样：全部由 WebAudio 振荡器实时合成（详见下面「声音设计」）。

> 角色形象是按「斗罗大陆里那位兔耳少女」的气质**原创绘制**的 SVG 小人（粉发、兔耳、长辫、
> 白色兔耳发饰、粉色裙装），不是任何动画素材或截图的搬运。

## 原创说明

这是本人（jxboop）的原创作品：

- **形象**：纯手写 SVG 绘制的 chibi 小人。粉发、兔耳、长辫、白色兔耳发饰、粉白连衣裙，
  都是一条条 `<path>` / `<circle>` 画出来的，没有使用任何动画截图、贴图或第三方素材。
  气质上致敬「斗罗大陆」里的兔耳少女小舞，但**不是**该作品的官方形象，也没有搬运其素材。
- **动作**：七个心情各自的 keyframes（呼吸、眨眼、甩辫、抡锤、蹦跳、垂耳、Zzz）为自己编写。
- **状态机**：`PetFollow` 如何把 DSH 会话事件折叠成心情、以及「先补读事件日志再判定
  成功还是报错」的时序，为自己设计。
- **声音**：全部由 WebAudio 振荡器实时合成，没有任何录音或采样文件。四音节旋律动机、
  FM 共振峰、气音瞬态、立体声摆位都是自己调参的。
- **代码**：Host 半边、浏览器半边与测试套件为本项目原创，采用 MIT 许可。

二次创作或商用请遵守 MIT 许可并保留作者署名。

## 目录

- [她长什么样](#她长什么样)
- [她会做什么](#她会做什么)
- [声音设计](#声音设计)
- [原创说明](#原创说明)
- [安装与卸载](#安装与卸载)
- [更新流程](#更新流程)
- [开发与自测](#开发与自测)
- [实现说明](#实现说明)
- [许可](#许可)

-----

## 她长什么样

纯手写 SVG 画的 chibi 小人，约 112px 高，贴在窗口右下角：粉发 + 前额刘海、两条细长兔耳、
一条垂到脚边的长辫（末端系蝴蝶结）、白色兔耳发饰、粉白连衣裙配缎带、脚上小圆靴。
她有一缕很淡的灵光在背后呼吸；眼睛会跟着鼠标转。

`preview.html` / `preview-zoom.html` 是真实浏览器渲染出来的七个心情状态预览页，
用浏览器直接打开就能看到（`preview-zoom.html` 是放大 4.2 倍细看版）。

## 她会做什么

心情由**当前会话**（`ctx.sessions.list.current`）的真实状态推导，不是随机播放：

| 心情 | 触发条件 | 动作 | 声音 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idle` 待机 | 会话空闲 | 呼吸、眨眼、耳朵轻抖、偶尔甩辫子 | 偶尔一声轻跳 |
| `think` 思考 | 正在跑，但还没发工具 | 左右轻晃、头顶冒「?」 | — |
| `work` 干活 | 最新事件是 `tool/call` | 抡小锤子、火星四溅、汗滴 | 每次新工具一声轻脆 tick |
| `wait` 等确认 | `approval/asked` 尚未 `decided` | 举手、头顶「!」、光圈脉动 | 柔和上行双音 |
| `done` 完成 | 一轮 `turn/end` 成功结束（running 由真变假） | 原地跳起、爱心+星星+音符 | **「做完啦……」** + 收尾闪音 |
| `oops` 出错 | `lastAgentError` 或 `turn/end reason=error` | 耳朵垂下、冒汗、掉泪 | 下行小三度 |
| `sleep` 睡觉 | 90 秒没动静，或还没打开任何会话 | 闭眼、冒 Zzz | 四声下行摇篮曲 |

交互：

- **点她一下**：蹦一下 + 一声「啵」，泡泡里冒出「呼哇～好舒服！」。
- **点右上角小喇叭**：开关声音（选择记在 `localStorage`，键名 `dsh-plugin-xiaowu:audio`）。
- **点状态胶囊 / 悬停**：展开小面板，显示当前心情、正在用的工具名、会话标题。
- 浏览器禁止自动播放音频，所以第一次点击/按键时才会解锁 AudioContext；解锁**之前**她依然会动，只是不出声。
- 尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`：动画会被压到最短。

## 声音设计

四段「咿呀」的旋律动机对应语音的音节节奏，全部由 `lib/client.js` 里的 `voice` 模块现场合成：

| 时间 | 音高 | 对应 | 音色处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00s–0.24s | G5 (784Hz) | 「做」 | 三角波主音 + FM 调制 + 气音瞬态 |
| 0.20s–0.50s | A5 (880Hz) | 「完」 | 同上，略强 |
| 0.47s–0.77s | G5 (784Hz) | 「啦」 | 同上，稍弱 |
| 0.75s–1.41s | D5 (587Hz) | 「……」 | 长音下滑，收尾 |
| 1.32s–1.82s | G5→C6→E6 | 闪音 | 铃铛式正弦 + 二次谐波 |

每个音节叠了三层：

1. **主音**：`triangle` 振荡器，带 5.4Hz 轻微颤音（`vibrato`），起音有 20–45ms 的滑入（`ramp`）。
2. **FM 调制**：`sine` 调制器以约 1.7 倍基频调制主音频率，做出类似人声共振峰的「唔」感。
3. **气音瞬态**：40ms 白噪声经带通滤波（中心频率约 1.7 倍基频），模拟辅音起音，让音节听起来像「说话」而不是纯音阶。
4. **低八度衬底**：每个音节再加一层低八度正弦，音量约 30%，让声音有胸腔共鸣的暖度，不会太尖。

再加一层立体声：四个音节左右轻摆（-0.22 / 0.06 / 0.24 / 0），闪音尾随其后，听感更「甜甜的」。
整段约 1.9 秒，主输出增益 0.9、单音峰值 0.13–0.20，保证不会突然吓人。

其他提示音（`hop` / `tick` / `chime` / `oops` / `pop` / `lullaby`）用同一套 `bell()` 原语拼出来。
想换音高或换成整句语音朗读，改 `phrase()` 里的 `notes` 数组即可。

## 安装与卸载

### 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 已在跑 `dsh web`（有 `web` profile） |
| Node.js | ≥ 18 |
| git | 安装时需要 |
| 浏览器 | 支持 Web Audio（Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari 都行） |

### 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jxboop/dsh-plugin-xiaowu.git
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/install.mjs
```

PowerShell（5.1 不支持 `&&`，用分号）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/jxboop/dsh-plugin-xiaowu.git; node .\dsh-plugin-xiaowu\install.mjs
```

脚本幂等，做四件事：

1. 把插件放进 `<DSH 主目录>/plugin-src/dsh-plugin-xiaowu`
2. 在 `<profile>/node_modules` 建链接（Windows 用 junction，**无需管理员权限**）
3. 把包名写进 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`（只改这一个字段）
4. 打印重启指引

然后：

1. `Ctrl+C` 停掉 `dsh web`，重新执行 `dsh web`
2. 浏览器 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新

**为什么必须重启**：bundle 列表与插件树只在进程启动时组合，热加载覆盖不到新装的插件。

常用参数：

```bash
node install.mjs --profile web            # 指定 profile（默认 web）
node install.mjs --dsh-home D:\dsh-home    # 自定义 DSH 主目录
node install.mjs --source ./本地目录        # 从本地目录安装（改代码时用）
node install.mjs --help
```

DSH 主目录默认按 `$DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh` 的顺序推断。

### 只想先看看她长什么样

不用装插件：用浏览器直接打开仓库里的 `preview.html`（`preview-zoom.html` 是放大 4.2 倍细看版）。

### 卸载

```bash
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/uninstall.mjs           # 移除链接与 bundles 注册，保留插件目录
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/uninstall.mjs --purge   # 连插件目录一起删
```

重启 `dsh web` 生效。

### 改完源码怎么生效

重开 `dsh web`（或重启当前那个进程），再刷新浏览器页面。
profile 的 `patchReload` 是 `live`，所以首页刷新会重新拿配置；但已经在跑的进程不会重新组合插件树。

## 更新流程（不用重启）

如果你的 DSH 装了 `dsh-super-injector`（本机开发常用的可选工具），改完源码可以热重载，不必重启：

1. **改**：动 `lib/client.js`（浏览器半边）或 `lib/index.js`（node 半边）。
2. **自测**：跑下面「开发与自测」里的测试。
3. **推送**：让注入器热重载这个包 ——

```
dev_reload_package  packageName: dsh-plugin-xiaowu
```

它清掉该包的模块缓存、重建 fiber，并把新的客户端 bundle 以新 revision 发布出去（失败会自动回滚保留旧代）。
之后**刷新浏览器页面**即可，不用重启 `dsh web`。

没有注入器也没关系：改完重启 `dsh web` 即可。

### 怎么确认刷新后跑的确实是新版本

bundle 里有一个版本戳常量 `BUILD`（`lib/client.js` 顶部，语义化版本，改完记得 +1）。
载入时它会把 `window.__DSH_XIAOWU__` 挂到页面上并打一行日志：

```
[xiaowu] 桌宠已载入 build 0.1.2 — window.__DSH_XIAOWU__ 可核对
```

刷新后的页面在 DevTools 控制台里敲 `window.__DSH_XIAOWU__.build`，跟文件里的 `BUILD` 对得上，
就说明这一页跑的是磁盘上这一版，而不是缓存的旧 bundle。

## 开发与自测

```bash
node --check lib/client.js      # 语法
node test/harness.cjs           # 无浏览器：挂载 + 状态机（各个心情逐个断言）
```

需要浏览器级渲染的测试要装开发依赖（只有改代码的人需要）：

```bash
npm i                           # jsdom / react / react-dom
node test/dom.cjs               # jsdom + 真 React 18：真渲染、真 DOM、真音频调度、版本戳
node test/preview.cjs           # 生成 preview.html / preview-zoom.html
```

## 实现说明

插件是**双面**的（DSH 客户端插件的标准形态）：

- **node 半边**（`lib/index.js`）：空的 `apply()`。它的唯一作用是让 Cordis 树里出现这一行，
  这样 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 扫描 `dsh.client` 声明时能发现本包。
- **浏览器半边**（`lib/client.js`）：手写的懒 CJS bundle，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`
  注册工厂；不需要任何构建步骤（没有 JSX，用 `React.createElement` 的 `h()` 小助手）。

浏览器半边做了三件事：

1. **占位**：`ctx.slots.inject("shell.overlay", …)` —— `shell.overlay` 是 ui-layout 声明的
   「整框浮动层」，本身是点击穿透的，所以 CSS 里只有 `.dsh-xw-stage` 把自己重新打开
   `pointer-events:auto`，不会挡住下面的界面。
2. **读状态**：`PetFollow` 跟着 `ctx.sessions` 走。它订阅会话列表（当前会话变化）、
   会话快照（`running`、`lastAgentError`、`awaitingFirstTurn`）和事件窗口
   （`turn/start`、`turn/end`、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`approval/asked`、`approval/decided`），
   把它们折叠成上面那张表里的七个心情。**顺序很讲究**：running 由真变假时先补读一遍事件日志，
   再判断是「做完」还是「出错」，所以一轮报错的 turn 不会被误当成成功来庆祝。
3. **画与响**：React 组件读 store，把心情写到 `data-mood` 上，CSS 里每个心情一套 keyframes；
   `useMoodSounds` 在心情**边沿**触发对应音效（`done` 边沿就是那句「做完啦……」）。

依赖清单写在自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（一行 insert），`package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject`
声明了必须先在线的客户端插件，剩下的 `react` / `react-dom` 走 DSH 客户端的静态模块表，不需要额外依赖。

## 许可

形象、动作、状态机与全部音频合成算法均为原创；二次创作或商用请遵守 MIT 许可并保留署名。

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: move sessions to a recoverable trash from the sidebar, restore or purge them from a settings page.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-trash **Session Trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop** — move a session into a recoverable trash from the sidebar menu, then restore or permanently purge it from **Settings → Session Trash**. English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![Session Trash icon](icon.svg) ## Summary Harness keeps every session log forever. `sessionPersistence` has no deletion API — *"Nothing deletes session files"* — and the workspace registry only archives, leaving the log on disk. This plugin adds the missing capability in the safest shape it can take: a **recoverable** move, a **user-only** trigger, and no filesystem path ever crossing the wire. ## Table of Contents - [Use this plugin](#use-this-plugin) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Safety model](#safety-model) - [Scope](#scope) - [Verification](#verification) - [Further exploration](#further-exploration) - [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) ----- ## Use this plugin | Where | What it does | |---|---| | Session row → `…` menu | **Move to trash** — the host's own `MenuItemButton` geometry (same height, padding, icon cell and label rhythm) with its danger colouring | | Confirmation dialog | Shows the title, original path and size before anything moves; the destructive confirm is the host's outline-with-red-text pattern | | Settings → **Session Trash** | Lists deleted sessions with **Restore** and **Purge**, plus **Empty trash** | | Host startup | Removes entries older than `retentionDays` (default 30), silently | A deletion **moves the session's directory** with a single `rename` into `$DSH_HOME/session-trash/-/`, and writes a `manifest.json` beside it. Nothing is copied, so an interruption cannot leave a half-deleted session, and a failed move leaves both directories exactly as they were. ### Install The plugin is an ordinary Harness bundle, so it installs where every other plugin does: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash ``` From a local checkout, point Plugin Manager at the directory (Settings → Plugins → Add, or the `plugin_manager` tool with `install_bundle`). The row it inserts is named `dsh-session-trash`, and it is enabled immediately. Restart Harness if Plugin Manager reports `restart-required`. ### Updating an installed copy A GitHub install copies the package into the profile's `node_modules`; it does **not** link back to a checkout. Editing a checkout therefore changes nothing until the change is pushed and the installed copy is replaced. ```bash cd git add -A && git commit -m "..." && git push ``` Then tell Plugin Manager to reinstall the bundle (`remove_bundle` followed by `install_bundle` with `github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash`, or the same two steps in Settings → Plugins). Reinstalling a package requires a Harness restart to load the fresh JavaScript generation for the Host half; the Client half is picked up on the next page load. If you would rather have a checkout's edits take effect immediately, install it by directory path instead — that produces a junction into the profile, and a moved or renamed checkout then breaks the plugin, because the link points at the old location. ## Configuration The bundle patch inserts the Host row with no config: the plugin resolves both roots from the running DSH home at activation, so a normal install needs no per-machine editing. Every field stays overridable from the profile's own patch layer. | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `sessionsRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | Where the session backend stores logs | | `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | Where deleted sessions go; must be on the same volume as `sessionsRoot` | | `retentionDays` | `30` | Automatic purge age; `0` disables the sweep | | `sweepOnStart` | `true` | Run the retention sweep once per Host start | | `maxTrashEntries` | `500` | Refuse new deletions above this count; `0` means unlimited | ```yaml - id: dsh-session-trash name: 'dsh-session-trash' config: retentionDays: 90 ``` ## Safety model Deleting a session is destructive, so most of this plugin is refusals rather than deletion. 1. **Recoverable by default.** A deletion is a move, not an unlink. Purging is a separate, explicit action inside the trash page. 2. **No path crosses the wire.** The client sends `{ op, sessionId }` or `{ op, trashId }`. The Host resolves identifiers against its own roots; there is no `path` field to smuggle. 3. **Identifiers are whitelisted** (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, ≤ 200 characters, never `.`/`..`) and every resolved path is checked with `path.relative` after `realpath`, so a symlink or a crafted id cannot escape a root. 4. **Directories prove their identity.** Before moving anything the plugin reads the log's header line and refuses unless `header.id` matches the requested session. 5. **Only a running turn blocks a delete.** Liveness is read exactly the way the shipped archive action reads it: an Agent counts as busy only while its `status` is `running`. An idle Agent that merely stays resident in the registry does **not** block — a session you already stopped is deletable. An Agent surface that cannot report a status is treated as running, so the plugin never guesses its way into moving a log that may still be written. 6. **A derived subagent session travels with its parent; a fork does not.** A session with `origin: subagent` exists only to carry out work for its parent, so a stopped one moves into the *same* trash entry and returns with the parent on restore. A fork (`isSeeded`) is seeded from the parent's history and then stands on its own: it stays put and does not block. A derived child that is still running, or that has children of its own, refuses the whole carry and says why. 7. **`rename` only, never copy-then-delete.** `EXDEV`, `EPERM` and `EBUSY` are reported as `cross-volume` / `busy`; no fallback exists that could leave a duplicate or a partial copy. 8. **Serialized mutations.** One promise chain per service, plus a re-run of every preflight immediately before the move, which closes the window between the dialog and the action. 9. **No agent tool.** The Host half registers no tool at all. Only a person clicking the UI can delete a session; the model cannot. 10. **One endpoint, behind the standard fence.** `POST /api/session-trash` is mounted on `ctx.connection.fetch`, so it inherits Harness's Host/Origin and browser-credential checks. Bodies are capped at 64 KiB, operations are a closed set, and failures answer with a stable `code` plus a fixed sentence — never a filesystem path. 11. **The Host log is the source of truth.** Deletion drops the session from the workspace pin/archive sets and emits `api-session/removed`, the same event the sidebar already listens for, so the row disappears immediately without any plugin-private state. ## Scope - **Allowed:** any session that is not running and whose derived children, if any, are stopped. - **Refused:** a running session or derived child, a derived child that has children, a directory that is not provably that session, and anything outside the configured root. - **Not touched:** attachments referenced by the deleted log (the attachment store is global and immutable), and projection-cache rows (they are hints only and self-heal). ## Verification ```bash npm test # 65 cases: paths, config, trash service, HTTP route, Client bundle npm run e2e # end-to-end walk through the HTTP handler npm run audit # read-only verdict for every real session on this machine npm run check:css # diff the copied styles against the host's own stylesheet npm run check:liveness ``` The suite builds throwaway session roots with real Zstandard logs and asserts: read-only preflight, identity-mismatch refusal, running and derived-child refusals, atomic move with rollback, manifest round-trip, restore collision, purge containment (`../../etc` is rejecte

plugins.description: Give the agent a real headed browser: browser_open and browser_interact tools over a stateful Chromium installed under the harness home
plugins.readme_text:
# 内置浏览器（dsh-browser）

给 Agent 一个**真实的有头浏览器**：`browser_open` / `browser_interact` 两个工具，跑在一个装在
harness home 下、状态可保持的 Chromium 上。

## 有什么

- **`browser_open`**：打开页面，返回可交互的页面状态。
- **`browser_interact`**：在同一个浏览器会话里点击、输入、滚动、读取——状态在多次调用之间保持。
- **设置页**：Agent 使用开关、请求头编辑器、Chromium 安装状态。
- **Chromium 管理**：检测 / 安装 / 复用，装在 `~/.dsh` 下，不污染系统。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin add @istarry/dsh-browser
```

装完重启 DSH 服务。**首次使用需要在设置页里安装 Chromium**（约 400MB 下载，几百个文件），
装好之后不再重复下载。

## 权限与行为

这是本插件最需要注意的部分——它不只是渲染界面：

- 会**下载并安装一个 Chromium 运行时**到 `~/.dsh` 下（首次约 400MB，需要网络）。
- 会**启动一个有头浏览器进程**（不是无头），占用内存与一个窗口。
- `browser_interact` 能让模型**操作真实网页**：点击、输入、提交表单。请在设置页里决定是否对
  Agent 开放（`agentUseBrowser`），并清楚这意味着模型可以碰到你打开的任何页面。
- 可自定义**请求头**（设置页），用于需要特定 UA / Referer 的场景。

## 兼容性

- 实测于 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。
- peer 依赖：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 等
  （见各自 package.json）。
- Chromium 运行时**不随包分发**，由插件在运行时安装到用户目录。

## 结构

| 包 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `@istarry/dsh-browser` | Chromium 运行时管理、`browser_open` / `browser_interact` 工具、安装/检测 Remote |
| `@istarry/dsh-client-ui-settings-browser` | 设置页：Agent 使用开关、请求头编辑、安装状态 |

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 给 DSH Web 侧栏腾点地方。 Too many DSH plugins, too little room.
plugins.readme_text:
# toomuch-plugins **Makes room in the DSH Web sidebar.** · *Too many plugins, too little room.* [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins/blob/main/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins) [![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- A small plugin set that gives the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web sidebar some breathing room. It ships one plugin today: | Plugin | What it does | | --- | --- | | Sidebar panel collapse | Collapses the "global panels" column above the workspace into one toggle in the sidebar footer | ## Why The DSH Web sidebar stacks, from top to bottom: brand row → new session → **global panel entries** → workspace → settings. Every plugin that adds a sidebar entry adds a row to that column: plugins, plugin market, schedules, MCP studio, context, skill manager, system monitor… Seven rows are roughly 280px, which squeezes the workspace region down to a few sessions. This plugin does exactly one thing: **collapse that column of global panel entries**, and bring it back when you need it. ## Highlights - **Collapsed by default** — the workspace gets ~280px back as soon as the plugin is installed. - **One toggle** in the sidebar footer, right above "settings". - **Remembered** in `localStorage`; survives reloads and restarts. - **Nothing else is touched** — no panel, no workspace, no host behaviour; only the display of the list element the sidebar already renders. - **Themed** with `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only, so it follows the DSH theme. - **Rail-friendly** — in the narrow 56px rail the toggle becomes a round icon button. ## Install The plugin is a repository-root package: it declares the `dsh.bundle` manifest, so DSH can install it straight from GitHub. ```sh # from GitHub dsh plugin --profile web add github:rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins # or from a local clone git clone https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins.git dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-toomuch-plugins ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm` inside the profile. After the install, **enable the plugin** in DSH's plugin settings (it is written into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`), then refresh the page. From the plugin market, once listed: open **Settings → Plugin Market** in DSH and search for `toomuch-plugins`. **Verify:** the sidebar footer gains a "Collapse global panels / Expand global panels" row above "settings", and the global panel column is gone. Requirements: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with a `web` profile; Node.js ≥ 20. ## How it works `src/client.js` does three things: 1. registers a toggle into the sidebar footer slot `sidebar.footer.action` (the row next to "settings"); 2. walks up from its own root node to find the sidebar root's direct `
` child — the global panel list — and toggles its `display`; 3. remembers the choice in `localStorage`. The basis is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`: `nav.panelList` is a direct child of the sidebar root, so walking up from the footer button always reaches it. Styling uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, and the stylesheet rides inside the component, so unmounting removes it. No DSH internal package is imported, and no DSH file is modified. The full contract is written down in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## Repository layout ``` . ├── package.json plugin manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client ├── cordis.patch.yml inserts the loader row into the profile ├── src/ │ ├── index.js Host half (no host capabilities needed; apply is empty) │ └── client.js Client half: footer toggle + collapse/expand logic ├── locale/{en,zh}.json title and description in the plugin list ├── docs/ design notes, market submission, pre-submit checklist ├── icon.svg icon ├── CHANGELOG.md └── LICENSE ``` ## Known limits - It collapses the **global panel entries** column only. The brand row, new session and settings are left alone — the brand row's "collapse sidebar" button is the only entry point on Linux / Windows, so hiding it would lose a feature. - With no global panels installed, the sidebar never renders that `
` and the toggle is a harmless no-op. - Verified on DSH Web (Linux) only. ## Plugin market DSH plugins are listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog, which aggregates the repositories carrying the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic. Add that topic to this repository, then open a one-file pull request against that catalog: the entry file is `data/plugins/__.yml`, with a `category`, a one-line `description.en` and an optional `description.zh` (the catalog's contributing guide has the exact rules). ## Related plugins - [dsh-sidebar-quiet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sidebar-quiet) — folds the sidebar **footer** rows (balance / import / memory / sign out) into one line - [dsh-sidebar-buttons](https://github.com/lywusichen/dsh-sidebar-buttons) — manage sidebar footer buttons: drag to reorder, show / fold into More / hide - [dsh-sidebar-pins](https://github.com/AndreyTepaykin/dsh-sidebar-pins) — a collapsible pinned-sessions block above the settings row - [dsh-sidebar-drawer](https://github.com/1dustycy/dsh-sidebar-drawer) — an edge-hover drawer that expands the sidebar - [dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility](https://github.com/Robert-Wang-08/dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility) — hide / collapse at the workspace level ## Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. Please include your DSH version, the browser, and whether the toggle appeared in the sidebar footer. Keep the change focused: this plugin does one thing, and the DOM contract it relies on is documented in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## License MIT © [rivenshanghai](https://github.com/rivenshanghai) — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 余额水杯 · Whale Balance｜DSH 插件：把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示成鲸鱼标志里上涨的水面｜DSH plugin: your account balance as water rising inside the whale mark, with spend stats, alerts and top-up.
plugins.readme_text:
# Whale Balance · 余额水杯

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

**English** — A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your account balance into water inside the whale mark: the level fills against a full amount you set, the surface keeps rippling, and a hover panel shows exact amounts, spend, remaining days and a top-up link.

**中文** — 把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示成鲸鱼标志里上涨的水面：水位按你设置的满杯金额线性变化，水面持续荡漾；悬停面板给出精确金额、今日/近 7 天消耗、还能用几天，以及充值入口。

---

## English

### Install

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-whale-balance
```

Straight from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/BugDesigner-Hy/dsh-whale-balance.git"
```

Then enable **Whale Balance** on the Plugins page. The plugin is also listed in the [Open Plugin Market](https://dshopen.org) — add `https://dshopen.org/index.json` under **Discover → Add index source** and search for `whale` or `balance`.

### What you get

- A 46px floating whale mark in the bottom-right corner (`shell.overlay`). Drag it anywhere; the position is remembered and clamped to the window.
- Clicking the mark unfolds it into a pill with a Casio-style LCD face on the right showing the live total: seven-segment digits, faint ghost segments, and a short digit churn when the amount changes. The pill hugs the amount instead of reserving a wide empty display. It unfolds toward the side with room — left by default, and when a dragged chip cannot fit to the right, it keeps its right edge and grows leftwards instead of leaving the window. Click again to fold it back; otherwise it stays open.
- Water height = `balance / full amount`, capped at full. The full amount is per currency and set in the panel's gear.
- Two drifting wave layers inside the whale silhouette, plus a ±4° sway of the mark so the tail moves most.
- Live balance from the account watch stream: login, top-up and sign-out push a frame immediately. Falls back to 60 s polling when the stream is unavailable.
- Hover panel: wallet totals with the bonus share in parentheses (gift icon + amount); click a currency to make it the vessel's basis. Also today's and last-7-day spend, an estimate of remaining days, a low-balance warning, refresh, and **Top up**.
- Clicking the mark only unfolds or folds the LCD face — it never navigates; top-up has its own link.
- Low balance: amber water and a soft breathing glow around the mark's edge. The threshold is either an amount or a percentage of the full amount.
- Only theme tokens for the container, focus rings and text; `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the ripples, sway, breathing glow and spinner. UI is localized (English / Chinese).

### Settings

| Setting | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full amount | ¥100 (USD $15) | Spendable total (recharge + bonus) at which the vessel is full; set 1000 to make 1000 the top |
| Alert mode | amount | `amount` or `percent` |
| Alert threshold | ¥5 (USD $1) | Below it the water turns amber and the mark's edge glows softly |
| Percent threshold | 10% | Used in percent mode: threshold = full amount × percent |

Full amount and amount threshold are stored per currency (CNY / USD); the percentage is global. Everything lives in `localStorage` and applies immediately; **Reset** restores the defaults.

### How the level works

- Linear: `(recharge + bonus) / full amount`, capped at 1. 40 of 100 fills 40% of the height.
- Spend figures come from the balance decreases this plugin observes while the app runs, so they are an estimate, not a bill. The ledger tracks the recharge and bonus wallets together (the platform spends the bonus first), and both the today and 7-day rows are always shown — `0.00` when nothing has been observed yet.
- Days left divides the usable total (recharge + bonus) by the extrapolated daily spend from the last seven days of observations, and stays hidden until there is at least one day of history.

### Where the data comes from

The browser reads the same account Remote as **Settings → Account**:

```js
ctx.get('remote').$stream({ name: 'account', open: (signal) => account.watch(signal) })   // live state
ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })          // balance
```

No API key is stored and the plugin makes no external network requests.

### Limits

- Spend history and settings are kept in `localStorage` per origin; a desktop build that changes ports starts collecting again.
- Spend is observed only while the app is running, so long offline periods are not attributed.

### License

MIT © 2026 BugDesigner-Hy. The whale path comes from the MIT-licensed DSH client primitives (© DeepSeek); see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

## 中文

### 安装

从 npm：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-whale-balance
```

直接从 GitHub：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/BugDesigner-Hy/dsh-whale-balance.git"
```

装好后到 **插件** 页确认「余额水杯」已启用。也可以在 **发现 → 添加索引源** 加入社区市场 `https://dshopen.org/index.json`，搜索 whale / 余额 找到它。

### 它在哪里

`shell.overlay` 里的一块 46px 悬浮徽标，默认在窗口右下角（距边 20px），不占布局、不遮挡滚动区域。

- **拖动**：按住徽标可拖到任意位置，松手后记住坐标（窗口缩小时会自动收回可视区）。
- **点击展开**：徽标展开成一条胶囊，右侧亮起电子表风格的 LCD 实时余额（七段数字、未点亮的「幽灵段」、金额变化时数字快速滚动一下），胶囊宽度随金额自适应，不多留空白；再点一次收回，不点就一直保持展开。默认贴着右边，所以是向左展开；如果拖到了别处，会先看右侧是否放得下，放不下就固定右边缘、向左展开，绝不越出窗口。全程不做任何跳转。
- **游动**：鲸鱼以身体为轴微微摆动（约 ±4°），尾巴的摆幅最明显；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下停止。
- **悬停 / 键盘聚焦**：在水杯上方展开面板（靠近窗口顶部时自动翻到下方，靠近左侧时改为左对齐）。
- **面板右上角的齿轮**：切换到设置，改完立即生效并保存；`Esc` 先退出设置、再收起面板。

### 面板内容

| 区域 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 标题行 | 标题 + 齿轮（设置）+ 刷新（读取时旋转） |
| 金额 | 各币种可用总额；赠送部分紧跟在后面，括号内以礼物图标 + 金额显示；点币种把它设为水位基准 |
| 统计 | 今日消耗、近 7 天消耗、约可用天数 |
| 提醒 | 低于阈值时出现琥珀色提示 |
| 底部 | 「去充值」+ 上次更新时间 |

### 设置（默认值可直接用）

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 满杯金额 | ¥100（USD 为 $15） | 水位到顶对应的可用总额（充值 + 赠送）。设成 1000，就以 1000 为满杯 |
| 提醒方式 | 金额 | 可选「金额」或「百分比」 |
| 提醒阈值 | ¥5（USD 为 $1） | 低于该金额时水体转琥珀、徽标外缘持续微微发光（呼吸感） |
| 百分比阈值 | 10% | 当提醒方式为百分比时，阈值 = 满杯金额 × 该比例 |

满杯金额与金额阈值按币种分别保存（CNY / USD 各一套），百分比是全局一个；`恢复默认` 一次还原全部。设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，修改后立即生效，无需重启。

### 水位怎么算

- 水位：**线性**，`(充值 + 赠送) / 满杯金额`。满杯填 100、可用总额 40 就是四成高；超过满杯金额则封顶为满。
- 低余额：可用总额（充值 + 赠送）低于你设置的金额阈值，或低于满杯金额的百分比，即触发提醒。
- 「可用天数」用观察到的近 7 天消耗外推日均（历史不足 7 天按已观察天数等比外推，不足 1 天则不显示），分子是「充值 + 赠送」的可用总额，只是趋势参考。
- 消耗完全来自本插件观察到的余额变化（只在应用运行时记录），是**估算**；把它当作趋势，不要当作账单。统计把「充值余额 + 赠送余额」合在一起算（平台先扣赠送），今日与近 7 天两行始终显示，尚未观察到扣费时显示 ¥0.00 并附一行说明。

### 数据来源

浏览器端读取本应用已挂载的账户 Remote：

```js
ctx.get('remote').$stream({ name: 'account', open: (s) => account.watch(s), ... })  // 实时状态
ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })  // 余额
```

即「设置 → 账户」页用的同一条通道。登录、充值、退出都会推一帧，水位随即更新；流不可用时自动退化为每 60 秒轮询，读取失败或服务未就绪时每 5 秒重试，页面隐藏时不发请求、重新可见时立刻刷新。

插件本身不保存 API Key、不发任何外部网络请求。

### 可调常量（`client.js` 顶部）

| 常量 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `REFRESH_MS` | `60000` | 轮询回退的刷新间隔 |
| `RETRY_MS` | `5000` | 未就绪/失败时的重试间隔 |
| `FALLBACK_FULL` | `{ CNY: 100, USD: 15 }` | 各币种满杯金额的默认值 |
| `FLOOR_LOW` | `{ CNY: 5, USD: 1 }` | 各币种金额阈值的默认值 |
| `DEFAULT_PERCENT` | `10` | 百分比阈值的默认值 |
| `DAY_MS` | `86400000` | 统计窗口单位 |
| `WATER` / `WATER_LOW` | 蓝 / 琥珀 | 水体与水面高光配色 |

### 主题与可访问性

- 容器、文字、边框只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量，跟随明暗主题；只有水体是美术配色。
- 徽标是真正的 `<button>`：可聚焦、有含金额与低余额提示的 `aria-label`；面板关闭时用 `visibility` 隐藏，不会进入 Tab 顺序。
- 数字输入框在失焦或回车时才提交，允许中途清空；`Esc` 在输入框内只还原输入，不关闭面板。
- 面板不挡鼠标：只有打开时才接收指针事件，并有一段透明桥接区域，鼠标从徽标移进面板不会闪断。
- 尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`：关闭波纹漂移、水位过渡、低余额呼吸光与刷新旋转。
- 文案走客户端 locale 服务（内置 en / zh）。

### 已知限制

- 消耗统计与设置存放在浏览器 `localStorage`（按 origin）。如果桌面端每次启动换端口，这些数据会重新积累。
- 「可用天数」依赖已观察到的消耗，长时间不用时消耗为 0，该项不显示。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 半侧：空座位，不注册任何资源 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半侧：水位徽标、拖动、面板、设置、余额与消耗统计 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入 `balance-vessel` 这一行 |
| `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json` | 插件管理器里的标题与说明 |
| `icon.svg` | 原创图标（水面与鲸尾），非官方商标素材 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |

鲸鱼轮廓路径取自本应用自带的品牌标志（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，MIT，© DeepSeek），其余图形与动效为原创。

### 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 BugDesigner-Hy。仓库里的鲸鱼路径来自同样以 MIT 分发的 DSH 客户端素材，署名见 LICENSE。

plugins.description: deepseek harness skills 安装管理， 适配skill-sh openclaw等通用skill
plugins.readme_text:
Skills Hub · 技能中枢

看清每个 Skill 在模型上下文里到底花了多少，并把不需要的从目录里摘掉——文件不删。

## 它解决什么问题 Skill 不是免费的。它对上下文的影响有三层，而 DSH 只把结果给你、不把账单给你： | 层 | 何时付费 | 现象 | | --- | --- | --- | | **目录行** | **每一次请求** | 每个 skill 的 `名称 + 截断后的介绍` 都在系统提示里 | | **目录副本** | 每次目录变更追加一份完整副本 | 改一次 skill，历史里就多一份完整目录，旧的不删 | | **正文** | 模型调用 skill 时加载一次 | 之后永久留在历史里 | Skills Hub 把这三层逐项量化，并给你一个不破坏文件的减负开关。 ## 功能 - **真实目录成本**：按 DSH 的渲染规则逐字计算（`- \`name\`: description`，空白归一化后按 `catalogDescriptionMaxLength` 截断，默认 500 字符）。token 为估算值（CJK ≈ 1.1/字，其余 ≈ 4 字符/token）。 - **模型实际看到的目录**：面板给出两个版本——**本会话已发布**（从会话里真实的 `skill-catalog` 消息取出，与模型收到的那条**逐字一致**）与**下次发布预演**（按当前配置推算，同样逐字对齐 DSH 模板）。 - **目录漂移告警**：当前技能集合与会话已发布的那份不一致时，提示「目录已变更：+ / - / ~，下次请求将追加一份完整副本」。 - **一键减负**：「从目录隐藏」写入 `disable-model-invocation: true`，文件保留、`/名字` 仍可手动调用，但不再进入模型目录，成本立刻归零。 - **分类筛选**：`全部` / `内置` / `第三方`（内置 = 随 DSH、插件或 Agent 预设安装，只读；第三方 = 装在项目或用户目录，可改可删），带数量、可与搜索叠加。 - **为什么模型看不到它**：DSH 对无效 frontmatter 是静默跳过的。面板列出磁盘上存在却没进目录的技能及原因（缺 frontmatter、name 非 kebab-case、布尔值非法、同名被高优先级目录覆盖）。 - **从 URL 导入**：ClawHub `clawhub.ai//`、Skills.sh `skills.sh///`、GitHub `github.com//[/tree//]`，文件由服务端拉取。 - **卸载**：两步确认，仅删除该 skill 的文件，不影响插件本体。


> 本插件不注册任何模型工具或技能，自身对上下文的固定占用为 **0 token**。 ## 安装 ### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub.git ``` 固定到某个提交（可复现）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub.git#" ``` 安装后重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → Skills Hub**。 ### 通过插件市场索引 本仓库同时是一份 DSH 插件市场索引（format 1）。在 DSH 里 **插件 → Discover → 索引源 → 添加** 以下任一地址： | 用途 | 地址 | | --- | --- | | 主地址（GitHub Pages） | `https://xiatian-wuhan.github.io/dsh-skills-hub/index.json` | | 备用（raw，立即可用） | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub/main/docs/index.json` | | 备用（jsDelivr 加速） | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub@main/docs/index.json` | 或让 agent 使用 `plugin_market` 工具检索该索引。发布新版本时运行 `node scripts/make-index.mjs` 更新索引（安装源会固定到该次提交）。 ## 使用提示 - 打开面板先看顶部「目录成本 / 次请求」；点「按成本排序」找出最贵的 skill。 - 描述被标「截断」的 skill，模型只看到前 `上限-3` 个字符——把介绍写短比写全更有用。 - 长期不用又不想删的 skill，点「从目录隐藏」：成本归零，文件与 `/名字` 调用都保留。 - 「本会话已发布 N 次」数字越大，说明目录变动越多，历史里的目录副本也越多。 ## 兼容性 - 需要 **DSH ≥ 0.2.0**（使用 `ctx.shell` 的 `execute()` 接口；0.1.x 的 `run()` 仍做了兼容）。 - Web 组合里 `dsh-base` 的全局 `skill-filesystem` / `tool-skill` 被 `dsh-web-app` 关闭，技能实际由 **Agent 预设作用域**提供。因此本插件按官方规则自行扫描 project / preset / user 各技能根，并与会话里已发布的目录交叉校验；若某部署的全局 `ctx.skills` 有内容，会自动作为覆盖层合入。 ## 开发 ```bash # 生成市场索引（提交代码后运行，写入 docs/index.json） node scripts/make-index.mjs # 本地安装调试 dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-skills-hub ``` 仓库结构：`index.js` 是 Host 半区（HTTP 路由 + 扫描 + 成本计算），`client.js` 是浏览器半区（设置面板），`cordis.patch.yml` 声明要注入的服务。 ## English **Skills Hub** shows what every installed skill costs in the model's context — the always-present catalog line, the full catalog copy appended on each change, and the body loaded on first use — and lets you hide a skill (`disable-model-invocation`) without deleting it. It also previews the exact catalog message the model receives (byte-identical to what `dsh-tool-skill` publishes), flags descriptions truncated by the catalog cap, and reports skills that exist on disk but never reach the catalog. Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub.git`, then restart `dsh web` and open **Settings → Skills Hub**. Requires DSH 0.2.0+. ## License MIT

plugins.description: Marginal notes for DSH. Mark assistant replies in the conversation and keep them as notes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-marginalia

在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话里，把助手回复中值得留下的句子标出来，收成笔记，并就其中一句接着问。问句开在旁边的侧栏里，主对话留在原来的页面。

Mark a sentence in an assistant reply inside DeepSeek Harness, keep it as a note, and ask about that sentence alone. The question opens in the side column. The main conversation stays where it is.

[中文说明](#中文) · [English](#english)

---

## 中文

这是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的一个插件。对话页上，「学习」和「对话」并列。空白的新对话不显示这排标签。

你留在对话里，选中助手写给你的一段话。光标右上方会出现一张白卡片，右键打开的是同一张。卡片上有四件事：

| 按钮 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 复制 | 把选中的这段放进剪贴板。 |
| 标红 / 取消标红 | 给这段加上或去掉红色标出。 |
| 划线 / 取消划线 | 给这段加下划线，或把下划线去掉。 |
| 提问 / 追问 | 就这段发问。已经问过的，接着问同一条。 |

自己发出的消息，以及思考过程，不会出现这张卡片。

### 笔记

标过的句子进「学习」页。每一条都能写批注、删除。页顶的「复制笔记」把当前这份列表复制成 Markdown。

笔记写在本机的 `~/.dsh/study-notes/`（Windows 上是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\study-notes\`），按工作区分开，里面是 `index.json` 和对应的 Markdown。不写进你正在打开的项目仓库。

同一段再选一次，按钮变成「取消标红」或「取消划线」，整条标注会从对话和笔记里拿掉。选区跟已有标注重叠，或去掉空白后是同一句，也算这一条。别处还有一句完全相同的文字时，会一起取消。

### 就一句话提问

选「提问」，写上例如「这段是什么」，也可以先选模型。

这句话会被划线。句末出现一个小引用符号：

- 合上时，只有这个符号。
- 点开后，是贴在这句话旁边的便利贴，里面是你的问题和这条进程最新的一条回复。
- 回复还没写完时，便利贴上是「正在回答…」。
- 按 Esc，或点「合上」，便利贴收起。

提问不会把主对话换成另一页。回答写在侧栏里，不写到主对话下面。旁边的「任务管理」仍能看见这条进程。

### 一条进程可以一直问下去

一条划线对应一条进程。不同的句子是并排的几条，互不套娃。

这条进程开在右侧栏，输入方式和主对话一样，新的一轮往下接在同一页。下面三种问法都进这一条，不会再套出「主进程 → 子进程 → 子进程」：

- 在侧栏里直接打字。
- 在主对话里对同一句再点「追问」。
- 在已经打开的这条进程里再划线追问。

它记得自己前面的回答。更早那种问完即止、不能接着写的进程，需要回到主对话重新提问。

### 模型

三处可以选模型：划线后浮出的提问卡、「学习」页上的提问或追问、以及已经打开的子进程输入框上方。

- 「跟随当前对话」：新开的这条用你当前对话的模型。
- 「沿用当前模型」：这次追问不换。
- 点名一个模型：新进程从这一轮就用它；已经打开的进程，从下一条回复起用它。正在写的那一条不会中途换掉。

列表里先是 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 DeepSeek Flash，然后是桌面配置 `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里写明的模型。没有的模型会提示「没有这个模型」。子进程页面上，软件自带的模型菜单不会出现，所以换模型用的是输入框上方这一处。

### 安装

把路径换成这套插件所在的目录。profile 名一般是 `desktop`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./path/to/dsh-marginalia
```

装好或更新后，把 DeepSeek Harness 完全退出，包括托盘图标，再打开。只关窗口不够。

要求 Node.js 20 或更高，DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3`。这份 0.1.0 是按桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2` 写的。

不要把本插件再写进 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`。命令行看到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 后，会自己把 `cordis.patch.yml` 接上。写两遍会挂两次。

### 边界

- 一次标注最多 4000 字。一条对话最多 400 条。一条批注、一个问题最多 2000 字。
- 便利贴里的回复最多显示 20000 字。
- 还没有自动整理，也没有导出 PDF。
- 进程没在运行时，换模型会提示「这条进程没有在运行，换不了模型。」

本地检查：

```bash
node --test lib/model.test.js lib/quote.test.js
```

## English

dsh-marginalia is a desktop plugin for DeepSeek Harness. On the conversation page, a tab named 学习 sits beside 对话. A blank new chat hides that tab row.

Stay in the conversation and select part of the assistant's reply. A white card appears at the upper right of the caret. A right-click opens the same card.

| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| 复制 | Copy the selection. |
| 标红 / 取消标红 | Mark the span red, or clear that mark. |
| 划线 / 取消划线 | Underline the span, or clear the underline. |
| 提问 / 追问 | Ask about this span. If you already asked, continue that same side conversation. |

Your own messages and the reasoning trace do not open this card.

### Notes

Marked sentences are listed on the 学习 page. Each row can take a comment, and each row can be deleted. 复制笔记 copies the current list as Markdown.

Notes are stored on this machine under `~/.dsh/study-notes/` (`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\study-notes\` on Windows), grouped by workspace, as `index.json` plus a Markdown file. They are not written into the project you have open.

Select the same span again and the button becomes 取消标红 or 取消划线. That removes the whole mark from the conversation and from the notes. An overlapping selection, or the same words with different line breaks, counts as that mark. The same quote elsewhere is removed with it.

### Ask about one sentence

Choose 提问 and type something like “这段是什么”. You can pick a model first.

The sentence is underlined, and a small citation mark sits at the end:

- Collapsed, only that mark is visible.
- Expanded, a sticky note beside the sentence shows your question and the latest reply.
- Until the reply is finished, the note says 正在回答….
- Esc, or 合上, closes it.

The question does not replace the main conversation. The reply is written in the side column, not under the main conversation. The side task list still shows this child.

### One child keeps going

One underline is one side conversation. Different sentences are parallel conversations. They do not nest inside each other.

The child opens in the right column. You type there the same way as in the main conversation, and the next turn extends downward on that page. These three actions all continue that same child:

- Type in the side column.
- Choose 追问 on the same sentence in the main conversation.
- Select text inside the open child and ask again.

The child keeps its own earlier answers. An older one-shot child cannot be continued. Ask again from the main conversation.

### Models

You can choose a model in three places: the card that appears after a selection, the ask form on the 学习 page, and the control labeled 模型 above the input of an open child.

- 跟随当前对话 starts the new child with the model of the conversation you asked from.
- 沿用当前模型 leaves the current model in place for this follow-up.
- A named model is used from the first turn of a new child, or from the next reply of a child that is already open. A reply that is already being written is left as it is.

The list starts with DeepSeek V4 Pro and DeepSeek Flash, then the models declared in `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`. An unknown model is refused with 没有这个模型. The app's own model menu is absent on a child page, so the switch for that page is the 模型 control above its input.

### Install

Replace the path with the directory that contains this plugin. The profile name is usually `desktop`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./path/to/dsh-marginalia
```

After installing or updating, quit DeepSeek Harness completely, including the tray icon, then open it again. Closing the window is not enough.

Requires Node.js 20 or newer, and DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3`. Version 0.1.0 was written against desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`.

Do not also insert this plugin into the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`. The CLI reads `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` and appends `cordis.patch.yml` itself. Adding it twice mounts the plugin twice.

### Limits

- One mark is at most 4000 characters. One conversation holds at most 400 marks. A comment or a question is at most 2000 characters.
- The sticky note shows at most 20000 characters of the reply.
- There is no automatic summary and no PDF export.
- If the child is not running, changing its model reports 这条进程没有在运行，换不了模型。

Check the package locally:

```bash
node --test lib/model.test.js lib/quote.test.js
```

## License

MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 Angry.fish. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: Give the whole left column back to the conversation on narrow screens: below 1024px the DSH sidebar leaves the frame entirely and a header button opens it as an overlay drawer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-sidebar

Give the whole left column back to the conversation on phones.

## What it changes

Below **1024px** — the same breakpoint at which `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`
auto-collapses the sidebar — the stock web shell still keeps a **56px icon rail**
(`computeColumns()` resolves the collapsed track to `collapsedWidth`, which is 56 on
the web; only macOS desktop and the Windows titlebar shell pass 0). On a 390px
viewport that rail eats 14% of the screen for a column you cannot read anything in.

This plugin, under the same breakpoint:

| | stock | with the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| frame tracks at 390px | `56px 334px 0px` | `0px 390px 0px` |
| collapsed sidebar | 56px icon rail | nothing — no track, no paint |
| opening the sidebar | squeezes the centre to 110px | 300px drawer over a 390px centre, tap outside to close |
| header | no toggle | panel-left button at the header's leading edge |
| ≥ 1024px | — | untouched (`280px 1000px 0px`, button hidden) |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-mobile-sidebar
```

`dsh plugin add` appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and hot-mounts it;
the browser only needs a **refresh** to load the new client combo. No `dsh web`
restart is required.

To remove it, delete the `"dsh-mobile-sidebar"` entry from `bundles` in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or disable the bundle from the Plugins
page.

## How it works

Everything is browser-side; the Host half is intentionally empty.

1. **Zero the sidebar track.** React writes `grid-template-columns` as an inline
   style, and a media query cannot override one track of it. A `MutationObserver`
   on the frame watches every solve, rewrites the value with **only the first
   track** replaced, and republishes it through the
   `--dsh-mobile-frame-cols` custom property. The centre and right tracks still
   matter between 800px and 1024px, where the right panel solves a real third
   track, so they are carried through untouched.
2. **Hide the rail without leaving the grid.** `visibility: hidden`, *not*
   `display: none`. A `display:none` box is not a grid item, so auto-placement
   slides the centre column into the now-0px first track and the conversation
   renders at zero width.
3. **Open as a drawer.** The column stays a grid item in its 0px track and simply
   overflows it (`position: relative` + an explicit width), so the centre column
   never changes width. A scrim in the `shell.overlay` slot closes it on tap.
4. **The toggle.** On the Conversation it is a primitives `Button` +
   `IconPanelLeftOutlineRegular` in the `conversation.header.leading` slot, calling
   `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`.

## Global panels (Plugins, Automation tasks, …)

The Conversation is the **only** panel that declares a header slot. Every other
global panel registers into the keyed `main` slot and builds its own heading —
Plugins renders `<header class="…pageHead">`, Schedules renders
`<div class="…pageHeading">`, and neither exposes anything to inject into.

So the toggle falls back to a fixed control rendered in `shell.overlay`, which
the shell always mounts at root scope. That covers every panel at once, including
panels that do not exist yet. Two rules keep it honest:

- **It steps aside on the Conversation.** `[frame]:not(:has([data-dsh-mobile-sidebar-button]))`
  is what hides it there, so the in-header button and the floating one never
  appear together.
- **It reserves its own lane.** Panel headings all start 28px down and 24px in,
  so the control would sit on the title's shoulder; a rule adds 40px of
  `padding-inline-start` to those headings while the control is present.

| where | control |
|---|---|
| Conversation | `conversation.header.leading` slot |
| Plugins / Schedules / any future panel | fixed control in `shell.overlay` |
| ≥ 1024px | neither |

## Screenshots

Closed on a phone — the rail is gone and the conversation keeps the full width:

![Mobile with the sidebar closed](docs/mobile-sidebar-hidden.png)

Tapping the header toggle opens the drawer over that same full-width conversation:

![Sidebar open as a drawer](docs/mobile-sidebar-drawer.png)

On a global panel the toggle falls back to a fixed control:

![Toggle fallback on the Plugins panel](docs/mobile-panel-toggle.png)

Above the breakpoint nothing changes:

![Desktop layout unchanged](docs/desktop-unchanged.png)

## Upgrades

The plugin targets source-written attributes, not the shell's CSS-module class
names (which are build-hashed and change between DSH releases):

- `[data-shell-overlay]` — the frame is its parent element
- `[data-slot="sidebar"]` — the sidebar column is its parent element
- `[data-sidebar-collapsed]` on the frame — closed vs. open
- `[data-plugin-panel]` — the one global panel that marks its section; the rest
  are matched on the `_pageHead` / `_pageHeading` class fragment

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Auto-recovery for DeepSeek Harness: continues turns that ended abnormally or were swallowed into plain text, and revives stalled model requests.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-unstuck

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的**监督员**插件。dsh 跑着跑着自己断了、卡住了、闷头不动了，它负责发现并把你解开（`unstuck`），不需要你手动发消息。

> **English** — A watchdog plugin for DeepSeek Harness. When a run stops on its own and waits for you to say something, this continues it.
>
> It handles three cases, and nothing else:
> - **Abnormal turn end** (`error`, `aborted` not caused by you, `max-tokens`, `interrupted`) — sends one "continue" after a short delay.
> - **Swallowed turns** — the turn is logged as `completed` even though the model meant to call a tool and an OpenAI-compatible relay emitted the call markup as plain text instead, leaving the agent silently idle. Detected structurally (the reasoning block and the text block are byte-identical, or the text is empty while reasoning is not, or the tail is a broken call tag) and continued with a pointed message asking for the tool call again.
> - **Stalled requests** — a model request was issued and then no stream frame arrived for `stallMs`. The turn is cancelled (`kind: 'hook'`, inbox kept) and continued.
>
> Waiting on an approval or on a question is logged and notified, never answered on your behalf. A stop you pressed yourself, a turn that really finished, and non-retryable errors (auth, quota, context overflow) are all left alone. Detection is pure structure over the session log — no judge model, no network calls.
>
> Install: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Chlyz621/dsh-unstuck` (or run `install.ps1` from a local clone). Config: `<DSH_HOME>/unstuck/config.json`. Log: `<DSH_HOME>/unstuck/unstuck.jsonl`. The detailed documentation below is in Chinese; `PLUGIN-NOTES.md` records why each decision was made.

---

## 它管三件事

| 现象 | 监督员怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 一轮对话异常结束（上游报错、输出被截断、进程崩溃留下的残局、非你按的中断） | 等一小会儿，补发一条「继续」 |
| **「假完成」**：日志写着这轮正常结束，其实工具调用被吞了、活没干完（最常见，见下节） | 补一条带指向性的「继续」，让它重新发工具调用 |
| 模型请求发出去了，但很久**没有任何流片段**（假死：TCP 断了但不报错） | 掐掉当前这一轮，再补「继续」 |
| 卡在等你审批 / 等你回答问题 | 只记录 + 通知，**绝不替你回答** |

不插手的情况：你按了停止、你这轮真的干完了、你正在输入（inbox 里有你的消息）、连续中断超过预算、认证失败这类再试也没用的错误。

「异常结束」具体指这几种 `turn/end` 原因：`error`（上游报错）、`aborted`（不是你按的停止）、`max-tokens`（输出被 token 上限截断）、`interrupted`（进程中断留下的残局）。

---

## 断连根因：中转站把工具调用吞成了正文

这不是猜的，是从真实会话日志里挖出来的。同一会话三轮，**每一轮都是这么断的**：

| turn | 末 step | 耗时 | 块结构 | reasoning 与 text | tool-call | 正文尾部 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 21 | 10.6s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `…</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>` |
| 2 | 138 | 4.5s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `…temp dir.</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>` |
| 3 | 10 | 18.4s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `Hmm, the`（断在词中间） |

同一会话 172 条 assistant 消息里，「reasoning 和 text 逐字节相同且没有 tool-call」只出现这 3 次 —— 正是被吞的 3 次，其余 169 条零误报。

**机理**：模型本来要发工具调用，中转站（`api: openai-completions` 兼容层）没能把 DeepSeek 原生的 `｜｜DSML｜｜` 工具调用标记转成 OpenAI 的 `tool_calls`，那段标记被当普通正文吐了出来。于是 assistant 消息里只剩 reasoning + text、没有 tool-call；agent 循环认为「模型没要求调工具 = 这轮说完了」，`turn/end` 记成 `completed`，agent 静默 idle。

你看到的现象就是「跑着跑着自己断了，得手动发一句才继续」。耗时正常（4.5–18.4s，不是超时）、长度不一（2868–8892 字符，不是 token 上限），所以既不是超时也不是截断，是**协议转换层偶发失败**。

dsh 自带的「继续」按钮也救不了它 —— 那个按钮把 `completed` 当「已收工」，直接拒绝续跑。本插件的 `continueOnSwallowed` 就是专门补这个洞。

### 想根治的话（可选）

根因在中转站那一层，插件只能兜底。能减轻的办法：

- **换模型**：`glm-5.3` / `kimi-k3-1` / `minimax-m3` 这些模型原生就是 OpenAI 风格的工具调用，不走 DSML，理论上不会踩这个坑。改 profile 的 `agent-default-model` 即可。
- **降 `reasoningEffort`**：`max` 会让 reasoning 特别长，长流更容易在中转站出错。降到 `high` 试试。
- **换官方端点**：DeepSeek 官方 API 不会有这层转换。

---

## 三个必须知道的默认行为

1. **只补「继续」两个字。** 它不猜你想干什么，也不改你的需求。续跑消息的来源标记是 `dsh-unstuck`，所以它不会把自己发的消息当成你在说话。
2. **有预算。** 同一个会话连续中断最多自动续跑 `continueMax`（默认 3）次，用完就停手并在日志里记一条 `continue-budget-exhausted`。你只要手动发一条消息，预算立刻清零。
3. **有退避。** 第 1/2/3 次续跑前分别多等 1.5s / 5s / 15s，避免把上游打爆、也避免烧钱。

---

## 安装

两种装法。只想装上用走第一种；要改代码或者离线装走第二种。

### 一、从 GitHub 装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile tauri add github:Chlyz621/dsh-unstuck
```

dsh 会把仓库取到 profile 的 `node_modules` 下并登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。装完**完全退出** DeepSeek Harness（含托盘图标）再打开。

### 二、从本地目录装（改代码时用）

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

装完**完全退出** DeepSeek Harness（含托盘图标）再打开。

脚本做三件事，每一步都会先备份：

1. 把插件复制到 `<DSH_HOME>\plugins\dsh-unstuck`
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\tauri\package.json` 里登记依赖并加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建一个目录联接，让 dsh 能 `require` 到它（不联网、不跑 pnpm）

参数：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1 -Profile tauri -DshHome C:\Users\me\.dsh -Force
```

卸载：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\uninstall.ps1          # 只从 profile 摘掉，插件文件留着
pwsh -File .\uninstall.ps1 -Purge  # 连插件文件一起删
```

---

## 怎么确认它活着

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\unstuck\unstuck.jsonl" -Tail 20
```

开机应该有一行 `{"event":"boot",...}`，里面能看到当前生效的配置和挂上了几个监听器。之后每次动手都有记录：

| event | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `boot` / `dispose` | 装上了 / 卸载了 |
| `continue-sent` | 补了一条「继续」（带 attempt、kind、code） |
| `turn-swallowed` | 发现「假完成」（带 why：`dsml-leak` / `echo-reasoning` / `no-output`） |
| `continue-skipped` | 判断过但没补（带 why：`user-abort` / `policy` / `stall-already-handled`） |
| `continue-deferred` | 本来要补，但你在输入或已经跑起来了（`user-took-over` / `inbox-busy`） |
| `continue-budget-exhausted` | 预算用完，需要人看一眼 |
| `stall-detected` | 判定假死（带 silenceMs） |
| `clock-jump` | 机器睡眠/事件循环被卡，这一轮巡检只搬时间锚点、不判定（带 gapMs） |
| `question-asked` / `approval-asked` | 记录了你被卡住 |
| `question-blocked` / `approval-blocked` | 卡太久，提醒你 |
| `request-retry` | 重试了一次模型请求（默认关闭） |

debug 级的记录（比如每轮一条 `running`）默认不落盘，只有 `verbose: true` 才写，免得把上面这些有用的记录淹掉。

---

## 调参

默认值够用。想改就把示例配置复制过去，改完重启 dsh：

```powershell
Copy-Item .\unstuck.config.example.json "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\unstuck\config.json"
```

优先级：内置默认 < profile 里 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 config < 这个 `config.json`（后者赢）。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关，关掉后一个监听器都不装 |
| `autoContinue` | `true` | 续跑总开关 |
| `continueMax` | `3` | 每个会话最多自动续几次 |
| `continueText` | `"继续"` | 续跑发什么 |
| `continueOnSwallowed` | `true` | 「假完成」也续跑，见「断连根因」一节 |
| `continueTextSwallowed` | 带指向性的一句 | 「假完成」时发的措辞 |
| `continueDelayMs` | `700` | 发现中断后先等多久 |
| `backoffMs` | `[1500,5000,15000]` | 每次续跑额外等待 |
| `continueOn` | 异常类原因 | 只在这些 turn 结束原因上续跑 |
| `skipCodes` | 认证类错误码 | 命中就不续（试也没用） |
| `autoRetry` | `false` | 模型请求层重试，**默认关**，见下 |
| `retryMax` | `2` | 请求重试次数 |
| `stallEnabled` | `true` | 假死检测开关 |
| `stallMs` | `180000` | 请求发出后多久没流片段算假死（3 分钟） |
| `stallResumeMs` | `800` | 掐掉后等多久再补「继续」 |
| `tickMs` | `15000` | 巡检间隔 |
| `hardStallMs` | `0` | 整轮零事件的兜底阈值，0=关闭（长工具本来就很久没事件） |
| `notifyBlocked` | `true` | 卡审批/等回答时提醒 |
| `blockedNotifyMs` | `120000` | 卡多久开始提醒 |
| `notifyCommand` | `""` | 额外执行的命令，`{msg}` 会替换成正文；留空只写日志 |
| `skipOwnedAgents` | `true` | 子 agent 不插手 |
| `verbose` | `false` | 连 debug 级也打印到控制台 |

### 和 dsh 自带「继续」按钮的关系

桌面端本来就有一个「继续」按钮（`POST /api/tauri/ui/session/resume`），它做的事和本插件一样：判断上一轮是不是正常结束，不是就补一条 `Continue the interrupted task...`。

区别在于**它是手动的**——得你去点。本插件把那套判断搬进进程内、按事件自动触发，而且更保守：

- 你按了停止 → 不续
- 认证失败 / 余额不足 / 上下文超长 → 不续（点了也没用）
- 连续中断超过 `continueMax` 次 → 停手并提醒
- 你的消息一进来 → 立刻让位

它发的消息 source.kind 是 `dsh-unstuck`，跟桌面端按钮的 `continue` 区分开，日志里一眼能看出是谁干的。反过来，如果发现会话里已经有一条 `continue` 或 `dsh-unstuck` 消息，本插件不会再补第二条。

### 和 dsh-purge 的关系

dsh-purge 自带一个 `autoRetry`（profile 里默认**开着**），做的是同一件事。所以本插件 `autoRetry` 默认 `false`，避免两边叠成 6 次重试。

想让监督员统一管：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里把 dsh-purge 的 `autoRetry` 设成 `false`，再把本插件的 `autoRetry` 设成 `true`。

---

## 桌面通知（可选）

Windows 上想收气泡提醒，把 `notifyCommand` 设成：

```json
{ "notifyCommand": "msg * {msg}" }
```

或者用 [BurntToast](https://github.com/Windos/BurntToast)：`pwsh -NoProfile -c "New-BurntToastNotification -Text 'dsh', '{msg}'"`。

---

## 它做不到的事

- **dsh 进程整个没了（崩溃、被关掉、桌面端退出）** —— 插件在进程内，进程死了它也跟着死，救不了。这种要靠外部守护进程，不在本插件范围。
- **模型一直返回同样错误** —— 预算用完后它只提醒，不硬刚。
- **它不替你回答提问、不替你点审批。** 这是故意的：那类决定不该自动化。

---

## 开发

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
node --test "test/*.test.js"
```

- `lib/core.js` 纯逻辑（判原因、算退避、造消息、读 session 事件），无副作用，好测
- `lib/config.js` 默认值 + 归一化 + 用户配置文件
- `lib/index.js` cordis 装配层，只管接事件和发消息
- `test/core.test.js` 逻辑单测；`test/plugin.test.js` 用假 ctx / 假 agent 跑装配层

改完 `lib/` 想让它生效，有两条路（实测过，别信「改 profile patch 就能热重载」这种说法，那个不成立）：

1. **改已安装目录里的文件** —— dsh 在监听 `~/.dsh/plugins/` 下的插件目录，文件一变，1~2 秒内自己 `dispose` + `boot`，不用重启。所以先同步：
   ```powershell
   Copy-Item .\lib\*.js $env:DSH_HOME\plugins\dsh-unstuck\lib\ -Force
   ```
   然后看 `~/.dsh/unstuck/unstuck.jsonl` 尾部有没有新的 `boot` 行。
2.

plugins.description: Browse archived conversations and restore them to the sidebar from Settings.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archived-sessions

**Browse archived conversations and restore them to the sidebar from Settings.**

A small DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an **Archived Sessions** page under Settings. It lists every archived conversation with its workspace and last-updated time, supports searching, and restores a conversation to its original workspace in one click.

## Features

- Lists archived conversations with title, workspace, and last update
- Search by conversation title or workspace
- One-click **Restore** puts the conversation back in its original workspace
- Live updates from the workspace archive stream
- Follows the host theme and UI language (English / 中文)
- No message content is read; the page only uses session metadata

> Archived conversations cannot be opened directly in Harness. Restore one first, then open it from the sidebar.

## Install

From GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:sy297/dsh-archived-sessions
```

Or install the prebuilt tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/sy297/dsh-archived-sessions/releases/latest/download/dsh-archived-sessions.tgz
```

Open **Settings → Archived Sessions** after installation. On some hosts a page refresh is needed after the first install.

## Compatibility

- Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer (the `settings.section` slot and workspace archive stream)
- Plain JavaScript; no build step or native dependencies

## 中文说明

在 **设置 → 归档会话** 中查看已归档的会话。支持按标题/工作区搜索，点「恢复」即可将会话放回原来的工作区。归档会话在 Harness 中本身不能直接打开，恢复后从侧边栏打开即可。

安装：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:sy297/dsh-archived-sessions
```
