plugins.description: General-purpose method for the DeepSeek Harness: a domain-neutral planning protocol whose plan structure is enforced by schema and validator, not just requested by prose.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-method

给 DeepSeek Harness 一个**通用做事方法**：任何非平凡任务先产出结构化执行计划，计划的结构由 schema 与校验器强制，不是靠提示词请求。

产出的是**最普遍**的计划，不是最快的。换领域、换执行者仍然成立。

## 为什么

快的方法都靠省略：省掉目标澄清、省掉方案比较、省掉约束、省掉验证。这些省略在自己熟悉的领域看不出来，换到不熟悉的领域就变成返工。

这个插件把这几项变成**必填且机器校验**，所以模型省不掉。

## 装

本仓库**未发布到 npm**，只能从源码 clone 后以链接方式安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LMQ00/dsh-method.git ~/Projects/dsh-method
dsh plugin --profile web add link:~/Projects/dsh-method
```

装完重启 `dsh web`。profile 的 `node_modules` 里应有 `dsh-method` 软链——`link:` 装完若缺这条软链，`dsh web` 会打印 `cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-method"` 并跳过该 bundle，重装一次即可。

## 用

```
/method            # 开启，直接说要做的事
/method off        # 关闭
```

开启后模型必须调用 `plan_submit` 提交计划。计划通过校验会落盘到 `<项目根>/.method/plan.md` 并把渲染后的全文回给模型，之后按计划执行。

## 计划被强制包含什么

| 项 | 规则 | 违反时 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 目标 | 一句话说清完成后的状态 | 拒绝 |
| 非目标 | ≥1 条明确不做的 | 拒绝 |
| 约束 | ≥1 条，标 `hard` / `soft` | 拒绝 |
| 方案比较 | ≥2 个候选，各写优点与代价，选中项必须是其中之一 | 拒绝 |
| 任务 | ≥2 个，id 唯一，依赖不许成环 | 拒绝 |
| 每任务失败原因 | ≥1 条 | 拒绝 |
| 每任务完成判定 | 必须可观察：一条命令 / 一个文件路径 / 一个数值比较 | 拒绝 |
| 验证 | 每任务都被覆盖，或一条 `task: "*"` 覆盖整体 | 拒绝 |
| 可逆性 / 置信度 | 布尔 + `high\|medium\|low` | 拒绝 |

「可观察」的判定标准是结构化的，覆盖技术与非技术两类：

| 类型 | 例子 |
| --- | --- |
| 命令 / 退出码 | `` `pnpm test` 退出码为 0 `` |
| 文件 / 产物 | `docs/plan.md 存在`、`report/q3.docx 不少于 20 页` |
| 数值 / 阈值 | `测试覆盖率 ≥ 80%`、`输出 42 行` |
| 对比 / 状态值 | `accepted 为 true`、`返回码为 0` |
| 他人确认 / 交付物 | `收到订票确认邮件`、`合同已签署`、`客户在验收单上签字` |
| 状态达成 | `页面能打开`、`样机通过跌落测试` |

`确认一切正常`、`` `好` ``、`go`、`make it happen`、`随便看看`、`「完成」` 这类只有形容词和程度副词、既不指向对象也不指向状态的空话会被拒绝。

## 两层强制

| 层 | 拒绝什么 | 在哪 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JSON Schema | 形状错：缺字段、类型错、枚举非法、多余字段 | provider 侧，`execute` 之前 |
| `validate.js` | 内容错：空串、条目不够、判定不可观察、依赖成环、验证没覆盖 | `execute` 内 |

Schema 用标准 JSON Schema（`required` 是字符串数组），**不是** `defineTool` 的 DSL。用 DSL 写法（属性上 `required: true`）会被 provider 拒绝：`Invalid schema for function 'plan_submit': true is not of type 'array'`。

## 结构

| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | 插件入口：`/method` 命令、`plan_submit` 工具、`method:policy` 提示词段 |
| `validate.js` | 计划内容校验，纯函数 |
| `state.js` | 会话投影（从会话日志折叠状态）+ 计划路径解析 |
| `methodology.js` | 提示词文本 |
| `selftest.mjs` | 68 项自测，全部执行真实代码 |
| `docs/插件说明.md` | 做什么、怎么用、计划必含什么、拦什么不拦什么、限制 |
| `docs/实现逻辑.md` | 状态模型、两层校验、判定判据、路径解析、渲染格式、宿主接口面 |
| `AGENTS.md` | 文档索引 + 开发规范，改代码前必读 |

## 状态怎么存

`sessionProjections` 从会话日志折叠，不自造事件类型——DSH 的持久化读路径会拒绝未知事件类型（除非带 `ignorable: true`，而 `Session.append()` 设不了）。

| 事件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `command/run`（`name: method`） | 记录待生效的选择 |
| `command/done`（配对 id） | `success` 才提交选择 |
| `tool/call`（`plan_submit`） | 按 `callId` 记下 `arguments` |
| `tool/result`（配对 id） | 非错误则解析该次的 `arguments` 并提交计划 |

待提交项是 **map 不是单值**，所以并行工具调用时每个 `plan_submit` 与自己的结果配对，不会互相抢。后完成的成功提交覆盖计划并递增 `revision`。

## 自测

```sh
node selftest.mjs
```

68 项，覆盖：合法计划接受、结构缺陷拒绝、依赖图缺陷拒绝、验证覆盖缺陷拒绝、元信息缺陷拒绝、边界（超长/`null`/非对象）、判定可观察性的双向误报与漏报、投影折叠（含并发、乱序、状态必须是无损 JSON）、错误路径可诊断、渲染。

## 已知取舍

- **判定靠词表，识别不了的说法会被误拒**：`酒店订好了`、`机票已出票`、`行程已排好` 这类中文口语完成态既不命中产物名词、也不命中状态词，会被拒绝；而同义的 `已完成酒店预订`、`订单已生成` 会通过。同一个意思因为措辞不同而结果不同，这是当前实现的缺陷。[待改] 方向是反过来只检测空话（黑名单），而不是枚举所有合法说法（白名单）。
- **`.method/` 落在项目根下**：首次落盘时会在 `.method/` 内自写一个内容为 `*` 的 `.gitignore`，让它整目录不进版本控制，不改你的根 `.gitignore`。
- **同一项目多会话共用一份计划**：路径按工作目录定位，不含 session id，两个并行会话会写同一个 `plan.md`。
- **没有强制中断**：`plan_submit` 只在 method mode 下可用，但插件不阻止模型不调它就直接干活。真正要强制，得靠 `tools.guard` 拦截写操作——那是另一个量级的设计，当前版本刻意不做，避免变成「不开 method 就不能干活」。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 会话回收站插件：头部垃圾桶按钮与侧栏「删除会话」先归档、可还原；设置页集中管理归档会话，可真正删除磁盘日志并支持批量清理。Session recycle bin for DSH.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-recycle-bin **DeepSeek Harness 的「会话回收站」插件** —— 把「删除会话」做成可还原的两步操作： 先移入回收站（只是归档，日志一个字节都不删），需要时一键还原，确认不要了再真正删除磁盘日志。 [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) ![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Afgkwyp/dsh-session-recycle-bin) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--rc.2-4b6bfb) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-43853d) ![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/fixture%20checks-32%2F32-2ea44f) > 零依赖、零构建、单文件宿主 + 单文件客户端。适用 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（Desktop / Web profile）。 --- ## 中文 ### 为什么需要它 DSH 自带的会话菜单只有 **重命名 / 分叉 / 归档**：归档只是把会话从侧栏藏起来， 磁盘上的日志原封不动；而想真正删掉一条会话，官方没有提供入口——`sessionPersistence` 的契约里明确写着「没有删除或保留 API，清理会话属于带外维护」。 于是想清理磁盘的人只能手动去 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\sessions\` 里删目录， 既容易误删，也容易把会话列表、投影缓存、工作区注册表搞得半死不活—— 而且删完还会留下一串空的 `--C-Users-...--` 项目文件夹。 这个插件补上这一环。 ### 功能一览 | 位置 | 新增的东西 | |---|---| | 会话头部（标题右侧工具行） | **垃圾桶按钮**：把当前会话移入回收站 | | 侧栏会话「⋯」菜单 | **删除会话**（红色，order 500，排在官方 pin / 重命名 / 分叉 / 归档 / 会话 ID 之后） | | 设置 → **会话回收站** | 归档会话集中管理：多选还原、永久删除、清空回收站、清理 30 天前；显示工作区路径、删除时间、日志体积、子代理会话数、「运行中」标记 | - **软删除**：头部按钮或菜单项 → 确认 → 会话从侧栏消失，进入回收站。 日志、子代理会话、投影缓存都还在，随时可以还原。 - **回收站**：成员 = 官方归档集合（`workspaceRegistry` 的 archived set）∪ 插件记录， 所以**通过官方「归档会话」归档的会话也会集中显示**在这里。 - **还原**：一键移出归档集合，会话回到侧栏原来的位置——磁盘文件从未被触碰。 - **永久删除**：真正删除磁盘数据（见下一节），并从归档 / 置顶 / 工作区成员中摘除引用， 最后广播 `api-session/removed` 让侧栏当帧移除该行。 - **批量清理**：多选批量还原 / 批量永久删除；「清空回收站」；「清理 30 天前」。 - **不留空文件夹**：删除后若该会话所在的「项目目录」（`sessions/--C-Users-...--/`） 已经空了，会一并删掉；插件激活时也会顺手清理历史遗留的空项目目录 （只删真正为空的，`sessions` 根本身永不删除）。 回收站的附加记录（删除时间 / 标题 / 工作区路径）写在 `$DSH_HOME/session-recycle-bin.json`；它只是展示用的旁路记录，删掉也不影响归档状态。 ### 永久删除会删除什么 | 位置 | 内容 | |---|---| | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<项目>/<会话 id>/` | 整个会话目录（`session.jsonl.zstd` 日志与写租约） | | 同一项目目录下的子代理会话 | 该会话名下每一层子代理 / 团队会话的日志目录 | | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<项目>/` | 若删除后已空，连项目目录一起移除（1.0.1+） | | `session_projcache` 存储域 | 该会话及其子代理会话的投影检查点行 | | `storages/workspace.json` | 归档 / 置顶 / 工作区成员里的引用 | | 页面 | 广播 `api-session/removed`，侧栏该行当帧消失 | **不删除**：附件对象（内容寻址、跨会话共享）、会话工作区里的文件（工作区可能被多个会话共用）、 分叉（fork）会话——它是独立对话，不会随源会话消失。 ### 安全边界 | 情况 | 行为 | |---|---| | 会话仍在运行（回合 / 子代理 / 后台任务 / 定时提醒） | 归档时拒绝，并提供「停止并删除」；走官方 `workspace/session-stop` 通道 | | 会话仍被当前进程持有（界面打开着） | 永久删除拒绝，提示先切换会话（避免活着的写句柄把日志写回来） | | 存储后端没有提供路径 | 按文档化的 JSONL 布局 `/<项目>/<会话 id>/session*.jsonl*` 扫描定位 | | 目录名与会话 id 不匹配 | 直接跳过并报告，**绝不猜路径** | | 待清理的项目目录不为空 | 保持原样，只删空目录 | | 子代理会话 | 随父会话一起删除 | 永久删除的执行顺序是有意编排的，不能交换： ``` 释放驻留会话 → 停止仍在跑的工作并等待清零 → 持久化 flush 屏障 → 删除日志目录/子代理目录/投影缓存 → 清理注册表引用 → 广播 api-session/removed ``` 先释放再停止，否则被停止的会话会唤醒 agent 重新干活，那份新工作会活过删除变成孤儿； 先释放再删文件，否则写句柄会在下一次 flush 把刚删掉的日志写回来。 ### 安装 **方式 A：图形界面（推荐）** 1. 克隆本仓库到任意目录： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Afgkwyp/dsh-session-recycle-bin.git ``` 2. 侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件** → 填**本地目录的绝对路径**， 例如 `C:\Users\<你>\Documents\dsh-plugins\dsh-session-recycle-bin`。 3. 宿主半即时生效；浏览器半刷新页面一次生效。 **方式 B：CLI** ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add "C:/path/to/dsh-session-recycle-bin" ``` **方式 C：手工写行**（等价于插件管理器做的事） ```yaml # /profiles//cordis.patch.yml - insert: - id: session-recycle-bin name: 'dsh-session-recycle-bin' ``` 并在同名 profile 的 `package.json` 依赖里加入 `"dsh-session-recycle-bin": "file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-recycle-bin"`。 **更新**：`git pull` 后，在插件页把本插件关掉再打开（重新装载宿主模块），再刷新页面； 替换已安装包时重启应用最稳妥。 **卸载**：插件页移除本插件即可；如需手工清理，删除 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `session-recycle-bin` 行、profile 依赖，以及 `$DSH_HOME/session-recycle-bin.json` （回收站旁路记录，删掉不影响会话本身）。 ### 验证安装是否生效 - 会话头部出现垃圾桶图标；侧栏「⋯」菜单出现「删除会话」； - 设置 → 会话回收站能列出已归档会话（底部显示 `$DSH_HOME` 与日志定位方式）； - 宿主半激活后会在 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-session-recycle-bin.json` 写一条激活记录 （构建号、seam、时间戳），排查「改了代码没生效」时先看它。 ### 配置（可选） 写在插件行的 `config` 下，全部可省略： ```yaml - id: session-recycle-bin name: 'dsh-session-recycle-bin' config: home: 'C:/Users/me/.dsh' # DSH 数据根目录，默认取 $DSH_HOME 或 ~/.dsh stopWaitMs: 8000 # 停止后等待工作清零的上限（毫秒） ``` ### 界面与实现 | 文件 | 职责 | |---|---| | `index.js` | 宿主半：`/api/session-recycle-bin.{health,list,archive,restore,purge}` 五条精确路由，注册在 Connection 的 `/api` 鉴权围栏内（没有该 seam 时退回 `webServer`） | | `client.js` | 浏览器半：头部按钮、菜单行、归档确认浮层、设置页；只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量，按钮/复选框按官方 `ui-primitives` 复刻 | | `locale/*.json` | 插件管理器里显示的标题与说明 | | `icon.svg` | 插件图标（原创） | | `test/host-test.mjs` | 宿主半 fixture 自测（假 Cordis 服务 + 临时 `$DSH_HOME`） | 浏览器半调用宿主半的方式与官方插件一致：同源 `fetch` + 自定义围栏请求头 `x-dsh-session-recycle-bin: 1`，并校验 Origin 只允许回环地址。 ### 自测 ```powershell node test/host-test.mjs # 或 npm test ``` 纯 Node、无依赖、不需要启动 Harness：用假服务跑真实 `index.js`，覆盖路由注册、 回收站列表、归档、还原、永久删除（含子代理目录、投影缓存、工作区摘除、 `api-session/removed` 广播）、空项目目录清理，以及后端提供/不提供 `locate()` 两条定位路径。 ### 常见问题 **删除了会话，为什么还留着一个空文件夹？** 1.0.1 之前只删会话目录，不处理变空的「项目目录」；1.0.1 起删除后会自动收掉空项目目录， 插件激活时也会清理历史遗留的空目录。升级后若仍看到，重载一次插件即可。 **点了删除，侧栏没马上消失？** 永久删除成功会广播 `api-session/removed`，正常当帧移除；若页面版本较旧或列表未刷新， 切一下会话或刷新页面即可。 **能删正在运行的会话吗？** 可以，但需要先停止它的工作——确认框会提供「停止并删除」，走官方停止通道 （注意它会丢弃该会话排队中的输入，与官方归档一致）。 **会删掉附件或工作区里的文件吗？** 不会。附件是跨会话共享的内容寻址存储；工作区可能被多个会话共用，两者都不动。 **支持多个 profile 吗？** 支持。装到哪个 profile，就只在那个 profile 生效；插件按 `$DSH_HOME` 解析日志位置。 ### 兼容性 - 实测于 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（Desktop，web profile，Windows）； - 需要组合中存在 `connection`、`sessionPersistence`、`workspaceRegistry` 三个服务； - 需要客户端存在 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`、 `conversation.session.header.utilities`、`shell.overlay`、`settings.section` 四个 slot； - 不依赖任何第三方 npm 包，也不 import 任何 Harness 客户端包。 ### 更新日志 - **1.0.1** — 永久删除后会清理变空的会话项目目录；插件激活时清理历史遗留空目录；仓库加入 fixture 自测。 - **1.0.0** — 首个公开版本：头部垃圾桶、侧栏删除会话、回收站设置页（还原 / 永久删除 / 批量清理）。 ### 许可 [MIT](LICENSE) --- ## English **A "recycle bin" for DeepSeek Harness sessions.** Deleting a session becomes a two-step, undoable operation: it first moves into the recycle bin (a plain archive — not one byte of the log is removed), can be restored at any time, and only a second, explicit action erases its data from disk. ### What it adds | Surface | Contribution | |---|---| | Session header (right-hand utilities) | A **trash button** that moves the current session into the recycle bin | | Sidebar session "…" menu | A **Delete session** row (danger, order 500, after the shipped pin / rename / fork / archive / session-id rows) | | Settings → **Session recycle bin** | Central management of archived sessions: multi-select restore, permanent delete, empty the bin, delete sessions older than 30 days; each row shows the workspace path, deletion time, log size, subagent count and a "running" tag | "Delete" means *archive*, so it is always undoable. Only "Delete permanently" touches the disk, and it asks first. ### What permanent deletion removes - the whole session directory `/sessions///` (the `session*.jsonl.zstd` log and its write lease); - every **subagent session** stored beneath it (each subagent session is a separate stored session whose log lives next to its parent's and would become unreachable); - the now-empty **project directory** `/sessions//` (1.0.1+); leftovers from earlier versions are swept on activation — only genuinely empty directories are removed, never the `sessions` root; - the session's `session_projcache` checkpoint row; - its archive / pin / workspace membership references; - and it broadcasts `api-session/removed`, so the sidebar row disappears without a reload. Never removed: content-addressed attachment objects (shared across sessions), files in the session's workspace (a workspace may be shared by several sessions), and forked sessions (independent conversations). ### Safety model - Running work (turn / subagents / background jobs / reminders) refuses the archive and offers **Stop and delete**, using the official `workspace/session-stop` admission. - A session still held by the process (open in the UI) refuses permanent deletion, so a live write handle can never recreate a removed log. - The log location comes from the persistence backend's `locate()` when available, otherwise the documented JSONL layout is scanned; a directory must be named exactly like the session id or the plugin refuses instead of guessing. - A project directory is removed only when it

plugins.description: 在 DSH 输入面板下方添加截图按钮：点击调用系统自带截图工具（Windows/macOS/Linux），截图后 Ctrl+V 粘贴进输入框
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-screenshot-button **在 DSH 输入面板下方加一个截图按钮，点了就打开系统自带截图工具。** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-6f42c1)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
--- ## 这是什么 `dsh-screenshot-button` 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的一个小插件： - 在 **composer 工具行（输入面板下方）** 注册一个相机图标按钮； - 点一下，宿主进程会调起**操作系统自带的截图工具**； - 框选完成后截图就在系统剪贴板里，回到输入框按 **Ctrl+V**（macOS `⌘V`）即可粘贴成图片附件。 不截屏、不读屏、不上传任何画面 —— 截图过程 100% 由系统工具完成，插件只负责"帮你按下那个按钮"。 ## 界面 输入面板底部工具行里的相机按钮（`+` 与「完全权限」右侧）： ![输入面板工具行中的截图按钮](docs/composer-toolbar.png) ## 功能 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 一键唤起系统截图 | Windows 用 `ms-screenclip:`，macOS 用 `screencapture -i -c`，Linux 依次尝试 gnome-screenshot / spectacle / scrot | | 主题自适应 | 按钮颜色全部走 DSH 主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），亮色/暗色自动跟随 | | 中英文案 | 跟随页面 `html lang` 自动切换 | | 防止连点 | 800ms 节流，避免叠开多个截图窗口 | | 安全边界 | 路由只接受**本机回环 Host** 的 POST，拒绝跨站请求；手机/局域网访问无法触发本机弹窗 | ## 安装 ### 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:SiriusWJ/dsh-screenshot-button ``` 例如桌面版： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SiriusWJ/dsh-screenshot-button ``` ### 方式二：本地目录开发 ```bash git clone https://github.com/SiriusWJ/dsh-screenshot-button.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-screenshot-button ``` 或者在 DSH 里用插件管理器安装本地目录（`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`，target 指向仓库根目录）。 安装后**重启 DSH**（客户端 bundle 在启动时扫描），输入框左下角就会出现相机按钮。 ## 使用 1. 打开任意会话，把光标放在输入框； 2. 点输入框左下角的**相机按钮**； 3. 系统截图工具弹出 → 框选/标注/复制； 4. 回到输入框按 **Ctrl+V**，截图变成图片附件，输入文字后回车发送。 > 按钮只负责唤起系统工具，截图结果由系统放进剪贴板，所以粘贴这一步交给 DSH 官方的图片粘贴能力，兼容性和拖拽发图完全一致。 ## 平台支持 | 平台 | 使用的系统工具 | 状态 | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows 10/11 | `ms-screenclip:`（截图工具 / 截图和草图） | 已实测 | | macOS | `/usr/sbin/screencapture -i -c` | 按 API 实现，未实机验证 | | Linux | gnome-screenshot / spectacle / scrot + wl-copy/xclip | 按 API 实现，未实机验证 | 不支持的平台会返回 `unsupported-platform`，按钮提示「当前系统没有可用的截图工具」。 ## 工作原理 ``` client (浏览器) host (DSH 进程) 系统 ────────────── ─────────────── ──── 点击相机按钮 │ POST /dsh-screenshot/capture ├──────────────────────────────► 校验 Host 是本机回环 │ 校验非跨站 / 同源 │ spawn(detached) ───────────► 截图工具弹出 │ { ok: true, tool } 300ms 内无 error 即成功 ◄──────────────────────────────┤ toast「已打开截图工具，Ctrl+V 粘贴」 ``` ### 插件结构 ``` dsh-screenshot-button/ ├── lib/index.js # 宿主端：webServer 路由 + 调起系统工具 ├── client/client.js # 客户端：conversation.input.left 按钮 ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle 补丁层 ├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件管理页标题/描述 ├── icon.svg # 插件图标 └── package.json ``` ### 宿主路由 | 方法 | 路径 | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | `POST` | `/dsh-screenshot/capture` | 调起系统截图工具 | | `GET` | `/dsh-screenshot/health` | 返回当前平台与可用截图入口，便于排查 | ## 常见问题 **Q：为什么点了按钮还要自己 Ctrl+V？** 系统截图工具把结果放进剪贴板，这是 Windows/macOS 截图工具的标准行为；DSH 官方输入框支持粘贴图片，所以这一步不需要插件介入。 **Q：为什么手机浏览器上看不到按钮？** 按钮本身会显示，但宿主路由只接受本机回环地址的请求（防止网页跨源弹本机窗口），所以远程访问时会提示「截图按钮只在本机 DSH 页面可用」。 **Q：能自动把截图插进输入框吗？** 当前版本不读取剪贴板（避免额外权限与隐私问题）。如果你需要"截完自动进输入框"，欢迎开 issue 讨论。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © SiriusWJ ---
English `dsh-screenshot-button` adds a small camera button under the DSH composer. Clicking it opens the operating system's own screenshot tool (Windows `ms-screenclip:`, macOS `screencapture -i -c`, Linux gnome-screenshot / spectacle / scrot). The shot lands in the system clipboard, so press `Ctrl+V` in the composer to attach it. The plugin never captures the screen itself; the host route only accepts loopback POSTs and rejects cross-site requests. Install: `dsh plugin --profile add github:SiriusWJ/dsh-screenshot-button`

plugins.description: Accept fake-IP DNS answers for DeepSeek Harness web_fetch while keeping the SSRF guard intact.
plugins.readme_text:
# Fake-IP Web Fetch

[![CI](https://github.com/Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-fakeip-http.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fakeip-http)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Make `web_fetch` work behind a **fake-IP DNS + TUN** setup without weakening
Harness's SSRF guard. Loopback, private, link-local, multicast, documentation,
reserved, and IP-literal destinations stay blocked.

![Fake-IP fallback decision path](docs/preview.svg)

> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## Preview

In a fake-IP environment, `web_fetch` enters the fallback only after the
built-in guard rejects the name.

```text
  web_fetch
     │
     ▼
  built-in SSRF guard ─── public ──────────────▶ unchanged
     │
     │ WEB_BLOCKED_URL
     ▼
  fake-IP policy
     │
     ├─ [ok] ordinary hostname, not an IP or local name
     ├─ [ok] every A/AAAA answer is synthetic
     └─ [ok] configured range avoids local/private space
     │
     ▼
  pin synthetic ──▶ TUN forwarder ──▶ target

  before   x  resolves to a non-public IP address
              DNS: 198.18.0.100, 2001:2::56
  after    ok HTTP 200 · text/html · example.com
```

The plugin does not add an allowlist entry: the public guard still owns the
first decision.

## The problem

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` resolves a destination before sending the
request and requires the **complete DNS answer set** to be public unicast. One
non-public answer is enough to fail:

```text
URL hostname "example.com" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

A fake-IP forwarder (Clash/Mihomo, sing-box, Surge, ...) answers almost every
name with an address from a reserved block, then maps the connection back to
the real destination inside its TUN. A host can look like this:

```text
example.com    -> 198.18.0.100, 2001:2::56
www.google.com -> 198.18.0.9,   2001:2::9
```

Those addresses are in the benchmarking ranges (RFC 2544 for IPv4, RFC 5180
for IPv6), so the built-in guard rejects the URL before a connection exists.
`curl` and a plain Node `fetch` succeed because they do not inspect the resolved
addresses.

## The fix

The plugin does **not** replace the provider and does **not** widen
`web.fetchProvider=http`. It finds the built-in `HttpFetchProvider` instance
and wraps the instance's `resolveAddresses` function:

1. **Run the original validator first.** A public destination, or a host with
   no fake-IP answer, follows the original path unchanged.
2. Only when the original validator throws `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` does the wrapper
   resolve the same hostname locally.
3. Accept the answer only when **the complete answer set** — every A and AAAA
   record — is inside an explicitly configured synthetic CIDR, and the hostname
   is eligible for fake-IP forwarding.
4. Return those synthetic addresses. The provider pins the connection to them
   exactly as it pins real public addresses; TLS SNI and the `Host` header stay
   the original hostname, so the TUN can map the connection back.
5. On any policy failure, rethrow the **original** error with a short
   diagnostic suffix.

This is not "add `198.18.0.0/15` to an allowlist". It is "accept this one
resolution only because the built-in guard already rejected it, the whole
answer set is synthetic, the name is an ordinary DNS name, and the synthetic
block cannot point at local or special-use space".

### Safety invariants

| Case | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Public real address | Original validator passes; unchanged. |
| Loopback / RFC 1918 / CGNAT / link-local / multicast / documentation / reserved | Refused; the fallback only accepts configured synthetic blocks. |
| IP literal (`http://198.18.0.1/`, `http://[2001:2::1]/`) | Always refused; never enters the fallback. |
| `localhost`, `*.localhost`, `*.local`, `*.lan`, `*.internal`, `*.home`, `*.corp`, `*.private`, `*.home.arpa`, `*.arpa`, `*.test`, `*.example`, `*.invalid`, single-label names | Never eligible for fake-IP. |
| Answer set mixes fake-IP and real addresses | Refused as ambiguous / DNS pollution. |
| Empty answer set or DNS failure | Original error. |
| Configured CIDR overlaps loopback, private, link-local, multicast, documentation, or other special-use space | Refused at load time, logged, and excluded from the policy. |
| IPv4-mapped IPv6 answer (`::ffff:198.18.0.1`) | Matched against the IPv4 synthetic blocks. |
| Explicit HTTP(S) proxy | Still resolved by the proxy (original logic); unaffected. |
| Every redirect hop | Re-resolved, re-validated, re-pinned (original logic). |

The special-use rejection closes an important hole: without it, a user could
configure `cidrs: [127.0.0.0/8]` or `fc00::/7` and turn the fallback into a
local-network gateway. A synthetic block must not overlap any range in
`SPECIAL_USE_CIDRS`; invalid or unsafe entries are logged and the remaining safe
ranges stay active.

### Why it is disabled by default

`enabled` defaults to `false` in code. The shipped `cordis.patch.yml` sets it
to `true` explicitly. Installing the package without the patch therefore does
not silently relax the guard; removing the config from the patch restores the
strict behavior.

## Install

Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web, `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.x`.
- `web.fetchProvider` must remain `http` (the default).
- A fake-IP forwarder reachable through the local resolver, with its synthetic
  range known.

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-fakeip-http
```

Published as [`dsh-fakeip-http`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fakeip-http)
by the `jayve-dev` npm account. The package is unscoped, so the install path is
just the package name.

### From GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http
```

### From a checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Jayve/dsh-fakeip-http.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-fakeip-http
```

The desktop app usually uses the `desktop` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-fakeip-http
```

The package is plain JavaScript with no dependencies and no build step, so git
and npm installs need no pnpm build approval and no `prepare` script.

Restart the Harness process after installation, then verify the layer:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Look for `# == dsh-fakeip-http` and an `enabled: true` fake-IP row.

### Verify

In a new session:

```text
web_fetch https://example.com
```

Expected: HTTP 200 and the page body. Then check that the guard is still
strict:

```text
web_fetch http://127.0.0.1:1203/   # still fails (loopback)
web_fetch http://198.18.0.1/      # still fails (IP literal, no fallback)
web_fetch http://10.0.0.1/        # still fails (private)
```

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-fakeip-http
```

Removing the bundle removes its patch layer; `web.fetchProvider` is untouched.

### Migrating from a local build

A local development row such as `@local/dsh-fakeip-http` uses the same row id
(`fakeip-http`). Remove that bundle first, then add this one, so the composed
config does not contain two rows with the same id.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: fakeip-http
  name: dsh-fakeip-http
  config:
    enabled: true
    cidrs:
      - 198.18.0.0/15
      - 2001:2::/48
```

- `enabled` (default `false`): accept synthetic answers. The shipped patch sets
  it to `true`.
- `cidrs` (default `198.18.0.0/15`, `2001:2::/48`): synthetic blocks the policy
  may accept. IPv4 and IPv6 both work. A block that overlaps special-use space
  is refused and logged; if every configured block is refused, the defaults
  apply.

Find your forwarder's range before changing this:

| Forwarder | Typical setting |
| --- | --- |
| Clash / Mihomo | `dns.fake-ip-range` (often `198.18.0.1/16`) |
| sing-box | fake-IP DNS server `inet4_range` / `inet6_range` |
| Surge | fake-IP range in DNS settings |

Use the range your forwarder actually emits. If it emits an IPv6 range as well,
include both. A range such as `28.0.0.0/8` is accepted if your forwarder uses

plugins.description: Offline audio-to-text for DeepSeek Harness: transcribe with SenseVoice and record system playback — fully local.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-audio-transcribe Offline audio-to-text for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), plus a floating widget that records whatever the machine is playing. Everything runs locally: no API key, no upload, no network at transcription time. > **Windows x64 only.** The recorder is a bundled WASAPI loopback binary. > **Tested against DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.** This plugin leans on two APIs the > upstream harness currently marks experimental: bundle loading via > `dsh.bundle.patch`, and index injection through `webserver/index-inject`. > Both have been stable across the 0.2.0-rc line, but a future DSH release may > change them. If the tools or the widget stop appearing after a DSH upgrade, > check this first rather than assuming the plugin is broken — see > [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](TROUBLESHOOTING.md). --- ## Install ### Recommended: clone and install from the checkout ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Anchoredship/dsh-audio-transcribe dsh plugin --profile web add file:D:\path\to\dsh-audio-transcribe ``` A `file:` install resolves straight from disk. It skips registry resolution entirely, so there is nothing for pnpm's build-script gate to block and no network to depend on. Use the absolute path, and keep the `file:` prefix — a bare `.\dir` becomes a `link:` symlink, and Node then resolves the plugin's DSH peer packages from the symlink target and fails to find them. ### Alternative: install from GitHub ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add github:Anchoredship/dsh-audio-transcribe ``` This fetches the sources and installs them through the registry. This plugin has no `install` / `postinstall` / `prepare` scripts and no native dependencies, so it should not trip pnpm's build-script policy. If pnpm does refuse with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, it is naming *some other* package being pulled in as a transitive dependency — follow its prompt to allow that package, or use the `file:` route above instead. ### Then Restart DSH. Transcription works without any extra download because it reuses the SenseVoice cache that DSH's own voice input already prepared — if that cache is absent, run `audio_model_download` once. --- ## What it looks like The expanded widget, with a recording in progress and three past recordings (two already transcribed):

## What it gives you ### Three model tools | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | `audio_transcribe` | Turn a WAV file into text with the local SenseVoice model | | `audio_model` | Report where the model lives and whether it is intact | | `audio_model_download` | Fetch the model (~230 MB) into a directory you choose | ### A recording widget A draggable pill in the bottom-right of the Web/Desktop GUI: - **Start / stop** capturing system playback (not the microphone) - Live timer, and it keeps counting while the panel is closed - **View and change** where recordings are stored - Lists recent recordings, and marks the ones that already have a transcript - **Auto-transcribes** each recording to a `.txt` beside the WAV --- ## Why recording needs a host process A browser cannot capture what the machine is playing. The widget is therefore a remote control: the buttons call host routes under `/dsh-audio`, and the host spawns `bin/LoopbackCap.exe` (WASAPI loopback, via NAudio) to do the capture. ``` widget (browser) ──HTTP──▶ host routes ──spawn──▶ LoopbackCap.exe │ /system-audio-*.wav │ SenseVoice ──▶ .txt ``` No virtual audio cable is required: WASAPI loopback reads the output device directly, without changing the default device or installing a driver. --- ## Storage | | | |---|---| | Default | `/audio-transcribe/recordings` | | Change it | **选择…** button (opens the OS folder chooser), or `POST /dsh-audio/dir.json` | | Persisted in | the plugin's `audio-transcribe` settings namespace | Changing the directory uses DSH's own directory-picker seam rather than a hand-rolled text box. That seam exposes a **capability**, not one fixed method set, because backends differ in interaction shape: ```js const cap = ctx.directoryPicker.capability() // { kind: 'native', pick(signal) } → OS folder chooser // { kind: 'browse', list(path?), createDirectory } → in-app tree ``` So the plugin asks the host which kind it has (`GET /dsh-audio/picker.json`) and renders accordingly: | Capability | Widget behaviour | |---|---| | `native` | **选择…** opens the OS chooser; manual paste stays as a secondary option | | `browse` | no tree is drawn; the widget says so and offers manual entry | | none | the picking button is hidden, manual entry only | The last case is deliberate: a composition with no picker backend must hide the affordance rather than fail. ### Which kind does this host get? `dsh-base` composes `dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`, which resolves once at boot: ```js if (bindHost !== '127.0.0.1') return 'browse' // remote browsers cannot reach an OS dialog if (ssh) return 'browse' // the chooser would open on an unattended server if (platform === 'darwin' || platform === 'win32') return 'native' ``` On this machine — Windows, loopback bind, launched locally — the answer is **`native`**, so the widget opens the real folder chooser. A picked directory is validated as writable before it is accepted, so a bad choice fails immediately instead of at record time. --- ## Model By default it reuses the cache that DSH's own speech input already prepared: ``` /speech-to-text/sensevoice/models ├── sensevoice-onnx/model.int8.onnx ├── sensevoice-onnx/tokens.txt └── silero/silero_vad.onnx ``` If that cache is absent, `audio_model_download` can fetch the pinned revision (verified by size and SHA-256) into the plugin's own directory. A fresh download never writes into the shared cache. Two layouts are supported when locating the files: the layered one above, and a flat directory holding all three files. ### Decode modes `auto` (default) picks per file: - ≤ 30 s → `whole` (one pass, fastest) - \> 30 s with ≥ 15 % silence → `segment` (Silero VAD splits the speech) - \> 30 s otherwise → `whole` up to 120 s, then `segment` `segment` output carries `[12.3s]` timestamps and handles long or pause-heavy audio better. Force either with `audio_transcribe`'s `mode` argument. --- ## Requirements | | | |---|---| | Platform | Windows x64 | | Runtime | reuses the sherpa-onnx build shipped with DSH Desktop 0.2.x | | .NET | built against the in-box .NET Framework 4.x | | Recorder | `bin/LoopbackCap.exe` + NAudio, bundled (424 KB) | Nothing is installed system-wide. --- ## HTTP surface All routes are host-owned and mounted under `/dsh-audio`: | Route | Method | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `/dsh-audio/status.json` | GET | Recording state, storage dir, recent files | | `/dsh-audio/start.json` | POST | Begin recording (`{ maxSeconds }`, capped at 7200) | | `/dsh-audio/stop.json` | POST | Stop and finalise the WAV | | `/dsh-audio/dir.json` | GET/POST | Read or change the storage directory | | `/dsh-audio/ui.js` | GET | The widget script | ### How the widget gets injected On the desktop shell, `index.html` is served from the packaged dist and never passes through `tapIndex`, so the only working channel is the structured row emitted on `webserver/index-inject`: ```js root.on('webserver/index-inject', (table) => { table.push({ kind: 'script', placement: 'body', text: INJECT_TEXT }) }) ``` It must be an **inline `script` row**, never `script-src`: a failing `script-src` rejects `__DSH_BOOT_READY__` and the whole app fails to start. The injected snippet creates the script tag itself and swallows `onerror`, so a missing route degrades to "no widget" instead of a broken app. --- ## Stopping cleanly `LoopbackCap.exe` watches for `.stop` and finalises the WAV itself. Killing the proc

plugins.description: Chinese-recipe browser RPA (webclaw-lite) + DeepSeek Harness dsh-plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# webclaw-oss

**Deterministic browser RPA driven by natural-language recipes (Chinese first).**

This repository is the open-source fork of webclaw for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) community (`dsh-plugin` topic).

## Core

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `runtime/` | Rust **webclaw-lite** CLI — parse Chinese recipes, drive local Chrome via CDP, HITL for captcha/slider |
| `packages/webclaw/` | npm **`@lonk1989/webclaw`** — Host tools + Skill that spawn lite |

Same recipe → same business path. Prefer fixing the recipe over inventing CSS selectors.

## Non-goals (v1)

- Not a Playwright / Stagehand / element-tool MCP
- Does not register exclusive `ctx.browserUse`
- No enterprise corp-session skill cloud
- Desktop Tauri UI is not part of the OSS v1 publish surface
- English recipe keywords are planned later

## Quick start

### 1. Install the DSH plugin (recommended)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @lonk1989/webclaw
```

On **Windows**, the plugin **auto-downloads** `webclaw-lite` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/lonk1989/webclaw-oss/releases) on first boot / tool call (SHA256 verified → `%LOCALAPPDATA%\webclaw\bin\webclaw-lite.exe`). No separate hand install.

Mount with an **`insert:`** patch (a bare `- id:` only updates an existing row):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: webclaw
      name: '@lonk1989/webclaw'
      config:
        registerSkill: true
        recipesRel: recipes
```

```sh
pnpm dsh web --patch examples/cordis.patch.yml
```

Ask the agent to run a recipe such as:

```text
打开https://example.com，等待2，采集
```

### 2. Local dev (optional)

Build lite from source when hacking the Rust CLI:

```powershell
cd runtime
cargo build --release --bin webclaw-lite
# then set config.binaryPath to ../target/release/webclaw-lite.exe
```

Plugin package:

```sh
cd packages/webclaw
npm install
npm run build
```

See [examples/cordis.patch.yml](examples/cordis.patch.yml) and [packages/webclaw/cordis.patch.yml](packages/webclaw/cordis.patch.yml).
## vs official browser-use

| | Playwright / CDP MCP | webclaw |
|--|----------------------|---------|
| Abstraction | Element / snapshot tools | Fixed Chinese **recipe** |
| Targeting | CSS / a11y | Visible text |
| HITL | DIY | Built-in `need_human` |
| Window | Often headless | Visible Chrome by default |

## Layout

```text
runtime/                 # Rust crate (lite-first, desktop feature opt-in)
packages/webclaw/        # @lonk1989/webclaw
examples/                # sample recipes + cordis overlay
skills/webclaw-lite/     # CLI Skill docs (source of truth also copied into plugin assets)
```

## License

MIT. Forked from the former vision-coord-client / webclaw product tree; tenant-specific defaults (CDN, corp auth, Feishu) were removed for OSS.

# dsh-freetap **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-freetap)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-freetap) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-freetap)](https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- dsh-freetap registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `dsh-freetap`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install Installs from a prebuilt release, so no build step and no toolchain is needed. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap/releases/download/v0.5.1/dsh-freetap-0.5.1.tgz ``` That is the whole install — one command, no extra flags, exit code 0. Then **restart DSH** and pick a model from the **dsh-freetap** group in the model selector. Requirements: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile, Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs), and outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. The install pulls **seven** small packages and runs **no** dependency build scripts, so it succeeds on a clean machine with pnpm's default (strict) build policy. That is a deliberate property of this package — see [Why the install needs no flags](#why-the-install-needs-no-flags). ### Why the install needs no flags Earlier builds depended on the full `@earendil-works/pi-ai` provider matrix at runtime. Two of its transitive dependencies declare install scripts, which pnpm blocks by default, and pnpm turns that into a hard failure: ``` Error: ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS × adding a new package ╰─▶ Ignored build scripts: @google/genai@1.52.0, protobufjs@7.6.6 ``` Worse than a plain failure: pnpm had **already written the dependency** into the profile's `package.json`, and DSH registers a package as a profile *bundle* only when the run exits 0. So the plugin ended up installed but never loaded — no model in the picker, nothing in the output explaining it. The fix is at the source rather than in the instructions: the wire layer is **bundled into the shipped `lib/`**, so none of those packages are installed at all. Today's published package depends only on `yaml`, `undici`, `partial-json` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` — none of which run scripts. Verify it registered: `dsh-freetap` must appear under `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`, not only under `dependencies`. ### Installing in the Web UI (recommended if you never use a terminal) **Settings → Plugins → Install**, then paste the tarball URL: ``` https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap/releases/download/v0.5.1/dsh-freetap-0.5.1.tgz ``` It installs in one pass. No approval dialog appears, because the package no longer depends on anything that declares an install script. If you ever *do* see an "Install scripts need permission" panel, you are on a build older than 0.5.1 — upgrade, or click **Allow these scripts and retry**. ### Other ways to install **From GitHub directly** (no registry involved): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap ``` This works because the repository root *is* the installable plugin: it carries the `dsh` manifest, and the built output is committed under `packages/plugin/lib/`. A git install cannot run a build — pnpm blocks prepare scripts for git dependencies — so shipping the build is what makes this path work. Pinning a tag is recommended for stability: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap#v0.5.1 ``` **From npm** (once the package is published): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-freetap ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **dsh-freetap** group. ### Updating Pick the source you installed from; each updates in place. **Release tarball.** Use the tag-scoped asset, not the version-free one: ```sh # replace 0.5.1 with the release you are moving to dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap/releases/download/v0.5.1/dsh-freetap-0.5.1.tgz ``` The version-free `releases/latest/download/...` URL does **not** update an existing install: pnpm resolved it once and pinned the URL plus its integrity hash in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so re-adding it is a no-op ("Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped") — even with `--force`, `pnpm update`, `pnpm install --force`, or a deleted `node_modules`. Only a URL that differs per release re-resolves. If you are stuck on an older build that predates the versioned asset, do the one-time move with an explicit remove + add (or the versioned URL, which works even then): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-freetap dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap/releases/latest/download/dsh-freetap.tgz ``` **git install**: follow master (a git spec re-resolves each time): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-freetap ``` **npm install**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-freetap@latest ``` Then restart DSH. To confirm the new version landed, compare the profile's `node_modules//package.json` with the release you expected, and check the health snapshot at `~/.dsh-freetap/adapter-status.json`. If an update ever leaves the plugin installed but not loaded, it is the `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` trap described under [Install](#install): remove and re-add, so the package counts as new and DSH registers it as a bundle. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The `name` must be the package you installed as: `dsh-freetap` for a git install, for the release tarball and for npm alike — there is one name now. ```yaml - id: dsh-freetap name: dsh-freetap config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: dsh-freetap refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local

# dsh-openspec-opsx

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Bring [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)'s spec-driven development workflows into DeepSeek Harness: **12 `openspec-*` skills** plus **12 `/opsx-*` slash commands**.

- No runtime dependencies beyond the host's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`; no third-party skill kit.
- Every command declares `input.hint`, so the composer highlights it and waits for arguments instead of firing immediately.
- A command injects OpenSpec's own generated workflow prompt; whatever you type after the command is appended under `## 用户输入`.
- Skill bodies and command prompts are generated verbatim by `openspec init --tools claude`; this repository only wires them into DSH.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-openspec-opsx
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Until the package is on npm, install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:IDrinkMoreWater/dsh-openspec-opsx
```

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/opsx-propose` | Create a change and generate all planning artifacts in one step |
| `/opsx-explore` | Explore mode: think before committing |
| `/opsx-new` | Scaffold a new change |
| `/opsx-continue` | Create the next artifact in dependency order |
| `/opsx-ff` | Fast-forward every planning artifact |
| `/opsx-apply` | Implement tasks from `tasks.md` |
| `/opsx-update` | Revise planning artifacts coherently |
| `/opsx-verify` | Verify implementation matches artifacts |
| `/opsx-sync` | Merge delta specs into main specs |
| `/opsx-archive` | Archive a completed change |
| `/opsx-bulk-archive` | Archive several changes at once |
| `/opsx-onboard` | Guided walkthrough of the whole workflow |

```text
/opsx-explore should the CLI grow a --watch mode
/opsx-propose move login from sessions to JWT
```

## Skills

`openspec-propose`, `openspec-explore`, `openspec-new-change`, `openspec-continue-change`, `openspec-ff-change`, `openspec-apply-change`, `openspec-update-change`, `openspec-verify-change`, `openspec-sync-specs`, `openspec-archive-change`, `openspec-bulk-archive-change`, `openspec-onboard`.

The model loads one by description when the task matches; you can also ask for it explicitly.

## Why not `/opsx:explore`

DSH's command-name grammar is `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/u` — a colon is not a legal character. Claude Code's `/opsx:explore` can only be `/opsx-explore` here.

## Prerequisites

- The target project needs an OpenSpec root: `openspec init` (or `openspec init --tools none`, since this plugin already ships the skills).
- The `openspec` CLI must be on `PATH`. This package's content is generated from **OpenSpec 1.14.3**.

## Regenerate for a newer OpenSpec

```sh
npm i -g @fission-ai/openspec@latest
node scripts/sync-openspec.mjs
```

The script runs `openspec init --tools claude` in a temporary directory (after opening the global workflow profile to all twelve workflows) and overwrites `skills/` and `commands/`. Commit the output so version drift stays reviewable.

## Layout

```text
index.js              registers skills and commands
skills/openspec-*/    12 SKILL.md files
commands/*.md         12 workflow prompts
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch layer
scripts/sync-openspec.mjs
```

## License

MIT. Skill and command text comes from [Fission-AI/OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec) (MIT).

# `/btw` side questions for DSH

[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

---

## 中文

Claude Code 的 `/btw` 让你在会话运行期间随时提一个快速问题，且这段问答不会进入会话历史。这个 bundle 把同样的行为带到了 DSH，并附带一个浮动答案面板。

### 它做什么

在输入框输入 `/btw <问题>`：

1. 命令**立即返回**——输入框马上清空，不会一直挂着这行命令等模型回答；
2. 读取会话的派生历史（`session.deriveMessages()`），即模型自己看到的那些消息；
3. 用会话当前的 provider/model 路由额外问一个问题，以上述转录为上下文，**不带任何工具**；
4. 答案流式写入输入框上方的浮动面板。

问题和答案只记录为仅日志的 `command/run` 和 `command/done` 事件，不会追加到模型可见的界面上，因此下一次模型请求不包含它们。

### 浮动面板

| 能力 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 流式 | 文字逐步出现；标题从 `正在思考…` 变为 `正在输出…` |
| 停止 | 「停止」中止当前调用；已产出的文字保留并附 `（已取消）` |
| 历史 | `‹ n/m ›` 与 `←`/`→` 翻看**本会话**之前的问答 |
| 问题 | 每条答案上方以灰斜体显示当时的问题 |
| 选中 | 面板内文字可自由拖选；「复制」可一键复制整条答案 |
| 追问 | 面板底部输入框可直接发下一个 `/btw`，不必回到输入框 |
| 选区提问 | 面板打开时若页面上有选中文本，会自动附带到追问中（chip 显示字数，点击可移除） |
| 持久化 | 槽位镜像到 `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-btw/<session>.json`；写入防抖、每周清理 |
| 隔离 | 每个会话独立的槽位，切换会话不会串台 |

### 配置

在 **插件 → BTW 临时提问 → 配置** 中可调：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | 空 | 路由覆盖，需与 `model` 同时填写；留空则跟随当前会话 |
| `model` | 空 | 路由覆盖，需与 `provider` 同时填写 |
| `maxAnswerTokens` | 1200 | 答案输出上限 |
| `transcriptChars` | 96000 | 转录预算（最新的优先保留） |
| `includeReasoning` | false | 是否把模型的推理过程放进转录 |
| `reasoningChars` | 500 | 开启推理时每条保留的字符数 |
| `toolArgumentChars` | 120 | 工具调用参数片段；`0` 表示不显示 |

同时填写 `provider` + `model` 可以让 `/btw` 使用比主对话更便宜/更快的模型。

### 限制

- 转录有上限（默认 96,000 字符，最新的优先）；单条超预算的内容保留**尾部**（报错通常在末尾）。
- 图片替换为 `[图片]`；工具结果以文本形式呈现。
- 旁路调用不触发 `agent/request`，因此不计入 token 统计，也不出现在请求头里。
- 聊天记录里保留一行中性指针（`已提交侧问：…`）作为归档；答案本体在面板中。

### 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-command-btw
```

或从 GitHub 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:wszw142857-beep/dsh-command-btw`

本包依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 以激活 Config schema；能解析该包的 profile 通常已自带。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 半边：注册 `/btw`、构建转录、流式侧调、维护槽位与 `/btw/answer` 路由 |
| `client.js` | Client 半边：浮动面板、轮询、翻页、复制、追问输入 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch，插入 `btw` 行 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件管理器中的标题与描述 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `test/btw.test.mjs` | fake-ctx 单测（24 项，无需 DSH） |

### 开发

```bash
node test/btw.test.mjs
```

以 `link:` 方式开发时，插件旁边需要有可解析的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（指向 profile 内副本的 junction 即可）；npm 安装会作为真实依赖自动装上。

---

## English

Claude Code's `/btw` lets you ask a quick question about the ongoing session while it works, and the exchange never enters the conversation history. This bundle brings the same behavior to DSH, with a floating answer panel.

### What it does

Typing `/btw <question>` in the composer:

1. settles the command **immediately**, so the composer clears the draft at once instead of holding the line until the model answers;
2. reads the session's derived history (`session.deriveMessages()`) — exactly the messages the model itself saw;
3. asks the session's provider/model route one extra question with that transcript as context and **no tools**;
4. streams the answer into a floating panel above the composer.

The question and answer are recorded only as log-only `command/run` and `command/done` events. They never enter the model-visible surface, so the next model request does not contain them.

### The panel

| Feature | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Streaming | Text appears as it is generated; the title reads `正在思考…` → `正在输出…` |
| Cancel | 「停止」 aborts the live call; produced text stays with a `（已取消）` note |
| History | `‹ n/m ›` and `←`/`→` page through this session's earlier answers |
| Question | Shown above each answer in italic grey |
| Selection | Text in the panel is freely selectable; 「复制」 copies one answer |
| Follow-up | The bottom input sends another `/btw` without returning to the composer |
| Selection-scoped ask | A page selection captured when the panel opens is attached to the follow-up (chip shows its size, click to drop) |
| Persistence | Slots are mirrored to `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-btw/<session>.json`; debounced writes, weekly sweep |
| Isolation | Each session has its own slot; switching sessions never shows another session's answers |

### Configuration

The plugin exposes these fields in **Plugins → BTW 临时提问 → 配置**:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | empty | Route override; requires `model`. Empty follows the session |
| `model` | empty | Route override; requires `provider` |
| `maxAnswerTokens` | 1200 | Answer output cap |
| `transcriptChars` | 96000 | Transcript budget (newest entries win) |
| `includeReasoning` | false | Include the model's reasoning blocks in the transcript |
| `reasoningChars` | 500 | Reasoning excerpt length when enabled |
| `toolArgumentChars` | 120 | Tool-call argument snippet; `0` disables |

Setting `provider` + `model` lets `/btw` use a cheaper/faster route than the main conversation.

### Limits

- The transcript is capped (default 96k chars, newest first); a single oversized entry keeps its **tail**, where errors usually live.
- Images become `[图片]`; tool results are plain text.
- The side call fires no `agent/request`, so it stays out of token accounting and request headers.
- The chat transcript keeps a one-line pointer (`已提交侧问：…`) as the durable archive; the answer itself lives in the panel.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-command-btw
```

Or from GitHub: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:wszw142857-beep/dsh-command-btw`.

The package depends on `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` so its Config schema activates; a profile that resolves that package already has it.

### Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: registers `/btw`, builds the transcript, streams the side call, owns slots + the `/btw/answer` route |
| `client.js` | Client half: the floating panel, polling, paging, copy, follow-up input |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `btw` row |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |
| `test/btw.test.mjs` | Fake-context unit tests (24 cases, no DSH needed) |

### Development

```bash
node test/btw.test.mjs
```

A `link:` development copy needs a resolvable `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` next to it (a junction to the profile's copy works); an npm install gets it as a real dependency.
